characters.title: https://forsaken.fntduserguide.com/img/noob-title.webp

abilities.name: BLOXY COLA
abilities.desc:
Noob drinks a can of **Bloxy Cola** for 2.5 seconds, during which they are unable to sprint. After finishing the drink, Noob is granted movement buffs and is cleansed of slowing effects. The effects are as follows:
•Grants ⟦Speed|I⟧ for 10 seconds
•Removes all existing ⟦Slowness|⟧ effects
•While drinking, Noob cannot sprint

**Using Bloxy Cola while Slateskin Potion is active:**

•Plays a boowomp sound effect

**Item Interaction:**

•Ability is treated as a Bloxy Cola item consumption for the purposes of Bloxy Cola speed
abilities.quote: "Warning: Bloxy Cola maybe bland-forming." - Roblox

abilities.name: SLATESKIN POTION
abilities.desc:
Noob drinks a bottle of **Slateskin Potion** for 1.5 seconds, during which they are unable to sprint and their movement speed is decreased by 20%, after fully drinking the **Slateskin Potion**, Noob gains some effects. The effects are as follows:
•Grants ⟦Slateskin|III⟧ for 6 seconds
••Provides 120 overheal but reduces speed by 45%
••Gains extra hit priority
•Can be recast after 2.5 seconds to remove the effect manually
•Cooldown only starts after 7.5s or if Noob manually cancels out

**Expiration:**

•If ⟦Slateskin|⟧ expires naturally, gives ⟦Speed|II⟧ for 2 seconds
•If ended manually, gives ⟦Speed|I⟧ instead.

• Guest 666 cannot collect Blood from Noob while the effect is active, Guest 666 also can't inflict ⟦Hemmorhage|⟧ on them, but drinking **Slateskin Potion** will not remove ⟦Hemmorhage|⟧ if it was already applied before being consumed.
•Dusekkar can stack the overhealth from ⟦Slateskin|⟧ with **Plasma Beam** and vice versa, and the overhealth will stay until ⟦Slateskin|⟧ ends.
•⟦Slateskin|⟧ doesn't make you immune to the On-hit speed boost, only the actual ⟦Speed|⟧ status effect.
abilities.quote: IM ROCK HARD!! - Homeless Guy

abilities.name: GHOSTBURGER
abilities.desc:
Noob eats a **Ghostburger** for 2 seconds, granting powerful stealth effects for a short duration. The effects are as follows:
•Grants ⟦Undetectable|I⟧ and ⟦Invisibility|IV⟧ for 10 seconds
•While eating, Noob moves 20% slower and is unable to sprint
abilities.quote: "What happens if you eat a ghost? You'll find out." - Roblox

abilities.name: CLONE
abilities.desc:
007n7 creates a clone of himself that persists for 10 seconds before disappearing. Upon activation, he gains ⟦Invisibility|IV⟧ and ⟦Undetectable|I⟧ for 5 seconds.

The clone wanders by default but can have its behavior modified using **Inject**. To 007n7, the clone is highlighted with a white aura.

**Clone Behavior:**

•Moves forward for an estimate of 0.5 seconds based on 007n7's facing direction upon creation.
•Does not gain speed boosts when hit.
•Plays running animations regardless of actual speed.
•Triggers the Killer's terror radius.
•Copies visual status effects.
•Bypasses ragdoll limits.
•If no Survivor is within 85 studs of the Killer, the Killer gains their normal 10% speed boost and does not drain stamina, even if a clone is nearby.

•Upon activation, 007n7 gains a hidden ⟦Helpless|⟧ status effect for 3 seconds.
•Clones grant John Doe ⟦Speed|⟧ when stepping into a **Digital Footprints**.
•Clones take hitbox priority when its health is greater than or equal to the health of a survivor also in the hitbox, and gets negative priority when its health is less. Also applies to buildings.
•The clone summoned will have the same health as 007n7 at the time of summoning and will have infinite stamina.

If a clone is already active, switching modes will not affect it. The clone will remain locked into the movement mode it was assigned when it was created.

characters.caption: SKATTINNGGGGGGG
characters.description: A rebellious robot, once with a heart for tags and shredding. Letting her pieces run all while she jumps, kicks, and flies through the air! If danger ever finds her, she can slip away rapidly and repair herself. Veeronica stands as a pillar of survivability. characters.lead: Veeronica is a FORSAKEN-original Survivalist Survivor, available for 750 Player Points. She is the eleventh Survivor introduced and was released in the Chapter 2: Strangers from the Past update on October 31, 2025, alongside Guest 666. Veeronica specializes in mobility and self-defense, using a skateboard and tricks to create distance from the Killer and even knock them back on impact. She also carries rechargeable batteries capable of restoring her own health, but cannot use any other healing items whether the batteries are active or not.
characters.title: https://forsaken.fntduserguide.com/img/veeronica-title.webp

abilities.name: METAL FRAME
abilities.desc:
Veeronica has a passive battery at the top right of her screen. Because she is a robot, she is prevented from using any healing items — including Medkits, Elliot's **Pizza**, or Builderman's **Dispensers**. Her rechargeable batteries are her only source of healing and can be activated through her **Activate Battery** ability. The effects are as follows:
•The Battery heals up to 50 HP at 100% battery charge.
•Starts each round with 30% charge.
•Completing a generator puzzle restores 8% battery per puzzle.

•Because the Battery value does not display decimals, the number shown for Veeronica's Battery can sometimes appear slightly inaccurate.
••For example, if she were to take exactly 8.6 damage at full health while at 100% Battery, she would lose 17.2% Battery, leaving her at 82.8% charge, which is displayed as 83%.
••For another example, if Veeronica's Battery is displayed as 50% and she completes a generator puzzle that grants 8% Battery, the result may be shown as 57% instead of 58%. However, if she completes the entire generator herself—or complete three additional generator puzzles—the Battery will display as 82%.
•Fake Generators don't restore Battery.
•Hallucinations of Elliot's **Pizza**, or Builderman's **Dispensers** do not affect her.
•Veeronica cannot place Graffiti on a hallucination of a Dispenser.
•**Metal Frame** is effective in private servers and cannot be disabled.
•Veeronica can use the “Fake Medkit” item in private servers.
abilities.quote: roger roger

abilities.name: VANDALISM
abilities.desc:
Veeronica can equip or unequip her spray paint, allowing her to spray Graffiti onto a wall by left clicking and holding. The effects are as follows:
•Takes 5 seconds to complete one piece of Graffiti.
•Each Graffiti creates a rectangular Graffiti Zone with a hitbox of 12×30×12 studs that phases through walls and enables the use of **Sk8** when inside of it, visible only to Veeronica.
•Can place up to 3 pieces of Graffiti at once.
•Graffiti cannot be placed within spray range (4×4×7) of each other unless Veeronica is behind a wall.
•There's a 1/25000 chance that a rare Graffiti, unlisted among the default Graffitis, may appear.

**Graffiti Erasure:**

•Veeronica can erase her own Graffiti by holding Spacebar near it with the spray can equipped.
•Graffitis have an erase range of 4×7×1 for Killers attack hitboxes.
••However, Veeronica can erase her own Graffiti as long as she is within 4×4×7 studs of the 4×7×1 Graffiti hitbox.
•Graffitis have 5 health and can be erased by the Killer.
•If any Graffiti is erased without Veeronica doing it herself, **Vandalism** goes on cooldown for 10 seconds.

•Graffiti can't just be placed on walls and structures. They can be placed on basically any surface that isn't another Graffiti, the Killer, or a Survivor. This includes: Invisible Barriers, Killer-Only Doors, Builderman's **Constructions**, Taph's **Subspace Tripmine**, Elliot's **Pizza**, 007n7's **Clone**, John Doe's **Corrupt Energy**, c00lkidd and 1x1x1x1's **Minions**, and Items.
••If a surface has Graffiti on it, it'll become erased and go on cooldown if said surface no longer exists. (I.E. Placing Graffiti on Taph's **Subspace Tripmine**, and then the trap explodes.)
••Graffiti does not automatically erase if the surface moves away from the graffiti(I.E. Placing Graffiti on John Doe's Corrupt Energy, and then the spikes sink into the ground for a bit before despawning.)
•If Veeronica is not facing a surface directly enough (around 50°), Graffiti will not be placed.
• On-hit effects can trigger by hitting Graffiti, though this currently only applies to John Doe's **Corrupt Energy**.
• Graffiti is placed directly in front of Veeronica, from head height and centered from the torso.
• Erased Graffiti plays a sound and shows an icon where it was placed.
• If the Killer destroys Graffiti, other pieces of Graffiti within 4.5 studs will be destroyed.
• Graffiti zones are highlighted to the Killer when Veeronica uses her **Sk8** ability.
• Being in a graffiti zone for an estimate of 0.5s will cause Veeronica's antennas to light up.
• Veeronica has to be standing on the ground for the spray can to work.
• Veeronica cannot place graffiti on Noli's Fake Generators.

abilities.name: SK8
abilities.cd: 0.5s(upon activation; can still trick but cannot recast)
abilities.desc:
Veeronica can only use **Sk8** while standing inside a Graffiti Zone. The effects are as follows:
•Moves at 1.15x (29.9 studs per second) running speed while skating.
•**Consumes 1.35x** (13.5 per second) **more stamina** than regular sprinting.
•Has very limited turning control while skating.

**Crashing and Penalties:**

•Crashing into a wall or the Killer with **Mobile** active deals 5 self-damage.
•Applies ⟦Slowness|4⟧ for 2.5 seconds upon crashing.

**Cancellation:**

•**Sk8** goes on a 5 second cooldown.
•Veeronica can cancel skating at any time by recasting the ability, this bypasses the ⟦Helpless|⟧ effect.
•If Veeronica's stamina runs out, **Sk8** ends immediately with no extended exhaustion, despite her increased movement speed while skating.
•When activating **Sk8**, the Graffiti piece she used becomes highlighted within 25 studs for 2 seconds (visible to both Veeronica and the Killer)

•Veeronica begins skating in the direction the camera is facing.
•While using **SK8**, Veeronica does not lose speed when falling and immediately moves at 1.15× her running speed without an acceleration window.
•**Sk8** retains the same target when yaw is stable, but camera pitch affects raycast hit precision, which can determine whether the system resolves a trick/crash cleanly or cancels **Sk8**.
••Veeronica can also get kicked out of **Sk8** by being slowed down too heavily, such as getting hit by 1x1x1x1's Entanglement and sometimes Noli's Nova.
•Veeronica cannot emote or use items while skating.
abilities.quote: subway surfers gameplay in the corner

abilities.name: SK8 - TRICK
abilities.desc:
When approaching a collidable surface (entering a 13-stud radius when going toward it, or a 3-stud radius when her side is facing it), Veeronica will glow and can perform a **Trick** by pressing Spacebar / X / Sprint (PC / Controller / Mobile) to rebound off it. Veeronica stays in the air for 1 second. The effects are as follows:
•The 1.15x speed boost while skating is increased to a 1.42x boost while in the air.
•Veeronica receives crash immunity for ~0.75s.
•Veeronica restores 4 Stamina.
•Performing 3 **Tricks** in a row charges Veeronica's Battery by 5%.
•Attempting a **Trick** on nothing will make Veeronica glow red while still putting **Trick** on cooldown.

•Veeronica's maximum jump height from performing a **Trick** is 10 studs.
•Interacting with an object will override the **Trick** input.
•**Sk8** does not account for certain collidable surfaces; attempting to skate on them will either allow Veeronica to pass through (common with smaller-than-normal objects) or cause Veeronica to be kicked out of **Sk8**.
••The cooldown on activating **Sk8** only applies to manual reverts; this action will end **Sk8** immediately.
•Holding the Spacebar / X / Sprint (PC / Controller / Mobile) while **Trick** is on cooldown will instantly activate **Trick** once again as soon as it's off cooldown, buffering **Trick**.
abilities.quote: NO WAY....

abilities.name: BROADCAST - PHASE
abilities.desc:
Veeronica can switch between 3 **Sk8** channels, each affecting her movement and interactions differently. These effects cannot be switched during **Sk8**.

•Upon colliding with a Killer:
••Gain ⟦Resistance|II⟧ for 3 seconds and ⟦Speed|II⟧ (35.88 studs per second) for 1.5 seconds.
••**Phase** through the Killer.
••Phasing charges Veeronica's Battery by 15%. (can only be used once per **Sk8**)

•**Phase**'s speed boost overrides other speed boosts (such as Bloxy Cola).
•**Phase**'s mechanic only triggers with Killer, not Minions.
abilities.quote: subway surfers gameplay in the corner

abilities.name: BROADCAST - BUMPER
abilities.desc:
Veeronica can switch between 3 **Sk8** channels, each affecting her movement and interactions differently. These effects cannot be switched during **Sk8**.

•Upon crashing into a Killer:
••Knock the Killer back.
••Charge Veeronica's Battery by 15%.
••Does not deal self-damage or apply ⟦Slowness|⟧.
•**Sk8** ends immediately if she crashes into the Killer.
•If the Killer has been hit by a **Bumper** in the last 20s, knockback will not occur.
••A meter appears above Veeronica's **Broadcast** ability when **Bumper** is selected to indicate its cooldown. If no meter is shown, **Bumper** is not on cooldown.

•**Bumper** deals 5 damage when colliding with the Killer.
•Knockback is ping-dependent, applying massive, minor, or no knockback based on the Killer's connection.
•**Bumper**'s mechanic only triggers with Killers, not Minions.
•Upon performing a **Trick**, the Killer is immune to **Bumper** knockback for 1 second (if this is not intended, this may be caused by the crash immunity granted upon performing a **Trick**).
•**Bumper**'s hitbox is dependent on the angle Veeronica is skating:
••Skating upwards will knock the Killer high up into the air.
••Skating downwards will push the Killer down, causing little to no knockback.
abilities.quote: subway surfers gameplay in the corner

abilities.name: BROADCAST - MOBILE
abilities.desc:
Veeronica can switch between 3 **Sk8** channels, each affecting her movement and interactions differently. These effects cannot be switched during **Sk8**.

abilities.name: ACTIVATE BATTERY
abilities.desc:
Veeronica begins slowly healing herself using her Battery. Healing stops if:
•Maximum health is reached.
•Battery charge runs out.
•Veeronica takes any damage (including Status Effects that deal damage over-time).

•Healing occurs at 1 HP per second.
•1 hp equals 2% of the battery
•If Veeronica has at least 1% charge, Battery can still be activated, restoring 1 HP even though the required threshold is not met.
•While the Battery is in use, gaining energy from other sources does not increase its charge.
•After ⟦Regeneration|⟧ ends, there is a very brief moment before Battery can be gained again.
•Damage only counts if it's health being lost, losing only overhealth will not cancel the healing as long as no actual health is lost.
•**Activate Battery**'s ⟦Regeneration|⟧ starts instantly after the ability is used.

abilities.name: SELF SACRIFICE
abilities.desc:
Guest 1337 has hit priority over other entities, such as survivors and structures. This increases the consistency of Guest 1337's defensive abilities and allows him to tank hits for teammates. It's worth noting that this passive becomes completely obsolete against piercing attacks, since they can hit multiple Survivors as long as they are within the hitbox.

**This mechanic has three tiers:**
•**Tier 1**:
••Standard priority.
••The entity closest to the Killer's hitbox is damaged.
•**Tier 2**:
••Guest 1337's default passive.
••If multiple players are stacked in the same position, he will always be hit.
••If multiple Guest 1337s are stacked, only one of them takes damage.
•**Tier 3**:
••Active only during Guest 1337's Block.
••Overrides Tier 1 and Tier 2.
••If multiple Guest 1337s are blocking in the same spot, only one of them takes damage.
abilities.quote: "You'll have to get through me first." - Guest 1337

abilities.name: BLOCK
abilities.desc:
Guest 1337 braces for an incoming attack, expanding his collision hitbox.
•Applies ⟦Resistance|V⟧ for 1 second.
•Movement speed is reduced by 50% for 1.75s.
•Only fully blocks Main Abilities (referred to as **Basic Attacks (M1s or M1 extensions)**), but is able to negate most ability damage.

**Upon successfully blocking a Basic Attack:**
•⟦Resistance|V⟧ is removed, and the damage is fully negated.
•Grants 10 stacking ⟦Overheal|⟧ that does not naturally decay, up to a maximum of 30.
•Guest 1337's movement speed is restored and they gain ⟦Speed|I⟧ for 2s.
•The Killer's movement speed is reduced by 30% for 1 second.
•Fully resets the cooldown of Guest 1337's **Punch**.

**If blocking an ability that is not a Basic Attack:**
•**Block** immediately breaks and restores normal movement speed. A special animation is played when this happens.
•Guest 1337 is hit normally, but the damage is reduced by 40%.
•Guest 1337 gains ⟦Resistance|II⟧ for 3s.

•Abilities will be locked out (non-visibly) for about 2s if Guest 1337 fails to **Block** any attack.
•Guest 1337 gains ⟦Strength I|⟧ for 5s upon a successful block.
•Guest 1337 cannot block more than one attack. This can be seen by blocking a killer's Basic Attack, then getting struck by an already-existing stray projectile.
•Despite having a Main Ability bind, Nosferatu's **Dive** does not count as a Basic Attack.
abilities.quote: "Stay strong, friend. I got your back." - Guest 1337

abilities.name: CHARGE
abilities.desc:
Guest 1337 lets out a battle cry and dashes forward in a shoulder-bash pose for 1.5s, having his stamina gain paused for the duration.

**If** Guest 1337 **collides with the Killer:**
•The Killer takes 5 damage and is knocked back depending on how long Guest 1337 charged, with a minimum of 6 studs and up to a maximum of 11 studs, charging over the course of 0.5s.
•Guest 1337 is inflicted with ⟦Resistance|III⟧ for 0.55s.

**If** Guest 1337 **does not collide with the Killer:**
•Guest 1337 receives ⟦Slowness|II⟧ for a duration equal to ( 3 × stud distance to nearest Killer) ÷ 13.
•**Charge** ends automatically if Guest 1337 crashes into a wall or falls off a high ledge.

•The knockback value of **Charge** is reduced by 10% for every additional Guest 1337 currently alive.

•Guest 1337 can "sprint" during **Charge**. However, this will only affect the stamina regeneration delay.
•Abilities are locked during and after **Charge** ends in any way for 1s. Disabling ability cooldowns via the Command Panel doesn't bypass this.
•The maximum ⟦Slowness|II⟧ duration Guest 1337 can get when missing a **Charge** is 15s, while the minimum is 3s. However, if Guest 1337 is near the killer when Charge ends, no penalty is applied.
•If Guest 1337 charges into a Killer who has already been charged within the past 20s, **Charge**’s effects will be nullified.
••A meter above Guest 1337's **Charge** ability to indicate its global cooldown. If no meter is shown, **Charge** is not on "cooldown".
•**Charge** can be manually canceled if the user starts repairing a Generator at the correct moment.
abilities.quote: "Incoming! Look out!" - Guest 1337

abilities.name: PUNCH
abilities.desc:
Guest 1337 pulls back his right fist before immediately swinging it forward, with varying results as documented below.

**Regular Punch**

If Guest 1337 uses the ability normally:
•Can only connect with one target and has a windup of 0.6s. **Does not stun**.
•The Killer is inflicted with ⟦Helpless|⟧ and ⟦Slowness|II⟧ for 2s on hit, lowered by 0.35s for every Guest 1337 currently alive.
•Deals 25 damage on hit.
•Knocks the Killer back by 7 studs on hit.

**Parry Punch**

If Guest 1337 uses the ability immediately after successfully blocking a Basic Attack:
•The hitbox pierces, and Guest 1337 receives ⟦Resistance|II⟧ during the reduced windup of 0.4s.
••The Killer takes 42 damage (actually 35) and is ⟦Stunned|⟧ for 2s on hit.
•Knocks the Killer back by 13 studs on hit.

•**Punch**'s icon turns yellow upon a successful Basic Attack **Block** to signify Guest 1337 is able to do a Parry **Punch**.
••Erroneously, this happens even if Guest 1337 blocks an ability attack.
•Parry **Punch**'s lunge stops prematurely if Guest 1337 connects with a target.
• **Punch** cannot interrupt active Killer abilities, and the knockback values of **Punch** are reduced by 10% for every additional Guest 1337 currently alive.

characters.name: Two Time
characters.caption: Shadows die twice.
characters.description: A fragile cultist that holds a terrible secret. Bearing nothing other than a sleek dagger and a manic smile, they're able to earn a second life through risk and sacrifice.
characters.lead: Two Time is a FORSAKEN-original Sentinel and Survivalist Survivor, available for purchase at 500 Player Points. A spiritual-based survivor. they can carve a Spawn Point into the ground and charge their passive Oblation bar using their dagger. The dagger can stab the Killer at any angle, with backstabs applying stronger effects and even stronger effects with **Crouch** backstab. All successful stabs contributes to filling the bar. They can either use this bar to heal themselves near the Spawn Point via **Pray**, or save it for a second life. Once full, if Two Time's health reaches 0, they respawn at their planted point with a second life, hence the name "Two Time". If the Oblation Bar isn't full, they die normally.
characters.title: https://forsaken.fntduserguide.com/img/two-time-title.webp

abilities.name: OBLATION
abilities.desc:
Two Time builds **Oblation** by dealing damage to the Killer, filling a meter that appears on the right side of the screen whenever damage is dealt. This meter determines whether they can respawn after death. Once full, dying will trigger a **second life** at their placed Ritual, but with reduced health and durability.

**Oblation Gain:**

•Front stab: +20%
•Backstab: +40%

**Second Life Activation:**

•If the **Oblation** bar is filled, Two Time will enter their second life upon taking lethal damage.
•Two Time is the last Survivor, but they will not respawn at their placed Ritual.

**Second Life Effects:**

•Respawns with 50 HP, which is 62.5% of their base health (80).
•Restores 40% Stamina.
•Removes all status effects.
•Gains 2 seconds of invincibility.
•Applies ⟦Speed|II⟧ for 6 seconds.
•Applies ⟦Vulnerable|V⟧ for 12 seconds.

**Limitations:**

•Requires a placed Ritual to activate.
•Without a Ritual, a full bar will not prevent death.

•Adds 20 seconds to the round timer upon triggering a second life, excluding Last Man Standing (LMS) respawns.
•Due to 2 seconds of invincibility, ⟦Vulnerable|5⟧ technically lasts 10 seconds.
abilities.quote: "You both shall set out on the grand step to rebirth." - ██████

abilities.name: SACRIFICIAL DAGGER
abilities.desc:
Two Time pulls out the **Ghostfire Dagger**, striking the Killer for damage and sustaining themselves. The outcome depends on positioning, rewarding precise backstabs with stronger effects.

**Activation:**

•0.3s windup.
•Grants ⟦Resistance|1⟧ for 0.7.

**On Hit:**

•**Front stab:**
••Deals 10 damage.
••Applies ⟦Slowness|II⟧ and ⟦Helpless|⟧ to the Killer for 1 second.
•**Backstab:**
••Deals 20 damage.
••The Killer is ⟦Stunned|⟧ for 2s.

**Stabbing while Crouched:**

•Transforms into a faster forward lunge that lunges you about **22 studs** with increased endlag and increase the Dagger stun duration ( 2s -> 3.5s )

**Limitations:**

•Landing a stab on a minion or a stun immune Killer does not grant Oblation.

•Named **Dagger** in-game.
•Cannot sprint during use.
•Dagger hitbox reaches up to **5 studs**
abilities.quote: "Lookie, █████-they gave us this cool knife!" - Two Time

abilities.name: CROUCH
abilities.desc:
Two Time enters a stealth state by **crouching** with their Ghostfire Dagger in hand, silencing their footsteps and preparing for an ambush.

**Effects while Crouched:**

•Applies ⟦Undetectable|⟧.
•Applies ⟦Invisibility|III⟧.
•Silences footsteps.
•**Crouching** and its effects last up to 15 seconds or until manually uncrouched
•Two Time's aura is revealed to other Survivors within 100 studs.
•Two Time will gradually gain speed while running towards the Killer, with this speed capping out on 40% over 4s. This speed boost is immediately lost if Two Time exits Crouch, takes damage, or stops running towards the Killer.

**If** Two Time **manually uncrouches:**

•Removes ⟦Undetectable|⟧ and ⟦Invisibility|III⟧.
•If within 30 studs of the Killer, gains ⟦Speed|II⟧ for 1 second.

•While **crouched**, Two Time's walk speed is reduced to 10 and their run speed is reduced to 20.
•For some odd reason, **Crouch** does not show it's cooldown when you are currently undergoing it's effects despite it ticking down.
•For some odd reason, if Two Time **crouches** before respawning during Last Man Standing (LMS), they remain **crouched** after respawning and are still highlighted.
abilities.quote: "Quiet, Two Time! They're not supposed to see us in here, hehe!" - █████

abilities.name: PRAY
abilities.desc:
Two Time will kneel near their RITUAL and begin praying while this ability is held.

•Letting go of the ability will stop PRAYING.
•While PRAYING, Two Time will rapidly exchange OBLATION progress for HP.
•Two Time will gain 1 HP for every 2% OBLATION progress spent, up to 50 HP at 100% OBLATION progress.
•If Two Time is not near their RITUAL when attempting to use this ability, the location of their RITUAL will be revealed to them for 4s.
•Two Time is unable to use this ability if they do not have a RITUAL.
•Two Time Gets their OBLATION Revealed to themselves while using this ability.
abilities.quote: "May spawn bless us today!" - █████''

abilities.name: RITUAL
abilities.desc:
Two Time carves a **Ritual** into the ground, marking a respawn point that enables their second life through Oblation.

abilities.name: COIN FLIP
abilities.desc:
Chance flips a coin—if an R appears, it is considered heads; otherwise, tails.

**Heads:**

•Gain 1 charge for all other abilities.

**Tails:**

•Gain 1 stack of ⟦Vulnerable|⟧ (+20% damage taken) for 15 seconds.
•Each consecutive tails increases the Weakness tier by 1 and refreshes the duration.
•⟦Vulnerable|⟧ has no stack limit.
•When ⟦Vulnerable|⟧ expires naturally, its tier does not reset; only **Hat Fix** can reset it.

**Coin Pit:**

•Each consecutive tails grants +2.5% increased chance for the next heads result.
•This bonus resets after the next heads.
abilities.quote:
"I gambled with my LIFE" -???
"did you win though" - Chance

abilities.name: ONE SHOT
abilities.desc:
Chance draws an unreliable flintlock and fires after a 1-second windup. One of three outcomes occurs:

**Explosion (25% → 15% → 5%):**

•Deals 25 self-damage.
•Breaks the flintlock until repaired by **Hat Fix**.
•Creates a 6×6×6 hitbox that stuns the Killer for ~5 seconds.

**Misfire (25% → 15% → 5%):**

•The gun fails to fire.
•Triggers cooldown.

**Successful Shot (50% → 70% → 90%):**

•Deals 50 damage.
•Stuns the Killer within 90 studs for 1–4 seconds (linearly decreasing with distance).

**Charge Scaling:**

•Each additional charge grants:
••+20% success chance
••-10% explosion chance
••-10% misfire chance
•Using **One Shot** consumes all charges from every ability.

•Shooting a Killer normally knocks them back by 5 studs, but if they are caught in the explosion, they can be pushed back up to 25 studs, potentially creating distance during a chase at the cost of Chance losing significant health.
abilities.quote: "You only have one shot." - Talking Cat

abilities.name: REROLL
abilities.desc:
Chance rerolls his Max Health to a random value between 55–120.

**Charge Multipliers:**

•1 charge → no bonus
•2 charges → Rolled HP is increased by +5% (0.05)
•3 charges → Rolled HP is increased by +10% (0.10)

**Formulas:**

•**New Max HP** = Rolled HP (55–120) × (1 + charge multiplier) (0.05 or 0.10)
•**New Current HP** = New Max HP × (old Current HP/old Max HP)
**Formula Example:**

•**Variables:**
••**90** Rolled HP; randomly rolled between 55–120
••**0.10** (10%); 3 charges
••**64/79**; old Current HP (64)/old Max HP (79)

•**Calculation:**
••90 × (1 + 0.10) = **99 New Max HP**
••99 × (64/79) = **~80.2 New Current HP**
••**Result**: 80/99 (80.2 is rounded to 80)
•••Both 64/79 and 80/99 maintain the ~81% ratio

**Caveats:**

•**Reroll** starts off with 0 charges and has a cap of 3 charges.
•Chance's new maximum HP cannot exceed 130 HP.
•Using **Reroll** removes all charges from other abilities.

•In the simplest explanation, without the math, **Reroll** either increases or decreases your current and maximum HP.
•**Reroll** does not restore HP directly. Instead, it scales both Max HP and Current HP by the same amount, keeping the remaining HP percentage unchanged. For example, 80/90 HP (~89%) becomes 99/111 HP (~89%) after **Reroll**.
•Since Chance's Max HP cannot exceed 130, the 3-charge bonus (10%) becomes less effective at high rolls. At the maximum roll of 120, the bonus would normally give 132 HP, but it is capped at 130. 120 × 1.10 = 132 → capped to 130.
••This means the actual gain is +10 HP instead of +12 HP. Because part of the multiplier is lost to the cap, the effective increase is reduced to about 8.33% at this upper limit (120 + 8.33% = 130).

abilities.name: HAT FIX
abilities.desc:
Chance fixes his hat. The effects are as follows:

•Resets all ⟦Vulnerable|⟧ stacks to ⟦Vulnerable|I⟧.
•Removes all active ⟦Vulnerable|⟧ debuffs.
•Can only be activated after accumulating 3 total charges.

•Using **Hat Fix** removes all charges from every ability and repairs **One Shot** if it has exploded.

•There is a 1-second delay before ⟦Vulnerable|⟧ stacks are actually reset.
•⟦Vulnerable|⟧ stacks not inflicted by **Coin Flip** can still be removed.

characters.name: Jane Doe
characters.caption: Do you still hold on to that fleeting light?
characters.description: A former tester for ROBLOX, one that was drowning in obsession and isolation. After gaining her ring, a reminder of who she is chasing after, Jane now has a new resolve. Utilizing the same corruption that once took him away, Jane is able to create openings for her hatchet from a distance and self-sustain through landing her abilities.
characters.lead: Jane Doe is a Sentinel and Support Survivor and the 12th Survivor added to FORSAKEN, introduced in Update 4.0.0 on March 18, 2026. Unlike other survivors, she cannot be unlocked using Player Points and must instead be obtained through her quest. She excels in sustainability and self-defense, possessing a built-in damage reduction shield separate from her main health that is strengthened by landing abilities. She can throw an explosive crystal to build up stun potential, strike the Killer with her hatchet to slow or stun it, and use that same crystal to support teammates by giving brief resistance.

abilities.quote: This passive has no official name nor displayed in-game. This passive will now be referred to as TILL DEATH DO US PART for ease of referencing.

abilities.name: DIGITAL FOOTPRINT
abilities.desc: Jane Doe is able to see the footprints of the Killer. The color of the footprints shifts based on their freshness: red → yellow →Grey gradually becomes more transparent until it disappears. While moving on footprints, Jane Doe receives a small 5% speed boost (NOTE: This is probably a bug).
abilities.quote: "JANE DOE TURNED SCARY AFTER MARCH 18!" - Some Robloxian

abilities.name: SHATTERPOINT
abilities.desc:
Jane Doe possesses a unique health system known as **Shatterpoint HP**, which cannot be healed by outside sources but benefits from 40% damage reduction.

**Base Stats:**

•Spawns with 20 **Shatterpoint HP**.
••Starter shatterpoints are reduced by 10% for every extra Jane alive.
•Can restore up to a maximum of 30 **Shatterpoint HP** through her abilities.

**Shatterpoint Mechanics:**

•**Shatterpoint HP** is restored by successfully landing abilities.
•If Jane Doe is reduced to 0 **Shatterpoint HP**, she cannot regenerate it for 40 seconds.

**Scaling Penalty:**

•For each additional Jane Doe alive, all **Shatterpoint HP** gained from abilities is reduced by 10%.

•When all **Shatterpoint HP** is lost, after 40 seconds you automatically regenerate 5 **Shatterpoint HP**, regardless of stacking penalties.
•**Shatterpoint HP** prevents being kicked off items and generators when taking damage.
•While Status Effects that deal damage over-time do not pierce through **Shatterpoint HP**, they still bypass the 40% damage reduction that **Shatterpoint HP** normally provides. Damage-over-time effects simply calculate their damage without applying her reduction. Because overheal values do not display decimals, this can cause Jane Doe's **Shatterpoint HP** to appear slightly inaccurate.
••For example, if she is hit by c00lkidd's **Walkspeed Override** while at maximum **Shatterpoint HP**, she will lose 28.2 **Shatterpoint HP**, which appears in-game as having 2 **Shatterpoint HP** remaining despite her technically only having 1.8 **Shatterpoint HP** left.
abilities.quote: "Throw everything you've got at me, I've got nothing to lose." - Jane

abilities.name: CRYSTAL PITCH
abilities.desc:
Jane Doe throws a jar containing an explosive crystal that detonates on impact with a Killer, Survivor, or any surface, creating an area-of-effect blast. The projectile travels in a slow arc by default, but can be charged for up to 2 seconds to increase its speed and explosion radius. Charging the throw reduces Jane Doe's movement speed by 30%, leaving her more vulnerable while preparing the attack.

**Upon Impact on Survivor/Killer:**

•**Survivor:**
••Grants ⟦Purified|1⟧ for 3 seconds.
••Restores 2 Shatterpoint HP to Jane Doe.
•**Killer:**
••Applies ⟦Resonance|I⟧.
••Restores 3 Shatterpoint HP.
••Reveals Jane Doe's aura to the Killer for 3 seconds.

**Long-Range Bonus:**

•Directly hitting the Killer from 110+ studs applies ⟦Resonance|II⟧.

**⟦Resonance|⟧ Mechanics:**

•Lasts 30 seconds.
•Reapplying refreshes duration and increases the level by 1, up to ⟦Resonance|III⟧.

**Limitations:**

•Cannot apply ⟦Resonance|⟧ if the Killer has been affected by ⟦Resonance|⟧ or ⟦Stunned|⟧ within the last 10 seconds.

•⟦Purified|⟧ grants resistance against attacks depending on how much health is missing from the affected survivor.
••This starts at 20% for every extra 20 HP missing from the affected survivor, and caps at 80% resistance with 80 HP missing.
•⟦Purified|⟧ and ⟦Resistance|⟧ stack additively. For example, 80% damage protection from ⟦Resistance|⟧ combined with 20% from ⟦Purified|⟧ results in 100% damage resistance.
•**Crystal Pitch** still restores Shatterpoint HP when it hits the Killer, even if ⟦Resonance|⟧ is not applied or the timer does not reset.
•**Crystal Pitch** applies the effects of hitting a Survivor to any humanoid that is not the Killer, including Minions or NPCs.
abilities.quote: "The same corruption that had taken over Him, was repurposed by me." - Jane

abilities.name: HATCHET
abilities.desc:
Jane Doe draws her **Hatchet** and prepares a swift attack against the Killer. After a 0.75s windup, she lunges forward and swings her **Hatchet** in a top-down diagonal arc from right to left, briefly gaining ⟦Resistance|1⟧ during the attack. If the strike connects, the target takes **25** damage **(10 damage if the target is John Doe)** and its effects vary depending on the Killer's ⟦Resonance|⟧ level.

**Base Hit (No ⟦Resonance|⟧):**

•Applies ⟦Helpless|1⟧ and ⟦Slowness|2⟧ for 2 seconds.
•Restores 5 Shatterpoint HP to Jane Doe.

**⟦Resonance|⟧ Scaling:**

•If the Killer has ⟦Resonance|1⟧:
••The Killer is ⟦Stunned|⟧ for 2.25 seconds.
••Jane Doe restores 10 Shatterpoint HP.

•If the Killer has ⟦Resonance|2⟧:
••The Killer is ⟦Stunned|⟧ for 3.25 seconds.
••Jane Doe restores 15 Shatterpoint HP.

•If the Killer has ⟦Resonance|3⟧:
••The Killer is ⟦Stunned|⟧ for 4.25 seconds.
••Jane Doe restores 20 Shatterpoint HP.

**Additional Notes:**

•Each ⟦Resonance|⟧ level increases the stun duration.
•The extra stun time begins at 1 second but is reduced by 30% for every Jane Doe currently alive.

•**Hatchet** still restores Shatterpoint HP on hit, but does not restore if the Killer is already ⟦Stunned|⟧ or if the strike itself fails to stun.
•Level 0 **Hatchet** works even if the Killer has stun immunity.
•**Hatchet**'s hitbox only hits one target.

characters.lead: Elliot is a Support Survivor and the first free Support character. As a medic, he can see the aura of injured Survivors and throw pizza slices that provide decent healing. He can also gain a short burst of high speed to evade the Killer, with charges given each time he throws a pizza. However, his health is lower than most Survivors, and he cannot heal himself with said pizza unless it comes from another Elliot.

abilities.name: ORDER UP!
abilities.desc: After the (generators) counter is incremented, Elliot gains a +2 increase to his healing. This bonus stacks up to +10, so completing five generators results in a potential 30 health restored per pizza.
abilities.quote: "Pizza! Pizza! Pizza! Pizza! Pizza! Pizza!" - Satisfied Customer

abilities.name: DELIVERER'S RESOLVE
abilities.desc:
Whenever any Survivor receives damage, their aura becomes revealed to Elliot for 12 seconds.

•⟦Undetectable|⟧ prevents Elliot from seeing other Survivors' auras.
•Taking damage from status effects doesn't reveal a Survivor's aura.
••Primarily map environment hazards, but also John Doe's **Natural Malevolence** and **Digital Footprint**.
•Losing overheal doesn't count, they must lose health (applies to Jane Doe's **Shatterpoint HP**).
•Chance's **Reroll** can trigger the effect if he got lower max health than what he had before rerolling.
•Veeronica can trigger the effect despite the fact that she cannot be healed by Elliot's pizzas.
abilities.quote: "Woah! That's some fast delivery!" - Satisfied Customer

abilities.name: PIZZA THROW
abilities.desc:
Elliot tosses a pizza that heals other Survivors on pickup, restoring instant and over-time HP while scaling with objectives.
•Restores 5 HP instantly and 15 HP over time to Survivors who pick it up.
•Pizzas are highlighted to Survivors within 200 studs for 25 seconds when thrown.
•Cannot be used by Elliot and despawns after 15 seconds.
•Healing is reduced by 25% per additional Elliot in-game, down to 80% effectiveness.
•**"Order Up!"** increases healing by +2 per completed objective (max +10).

•⟦Regeneration|⟧ is canceled only if 5 or more HP is lost in a single hit.
•Overhealth (e.g., Noob's **Slateskin Potion**) does not cancel regeneration since no real HP is lost.
•The pizzas have a timer above them showing how many seconds are left before they despawn. Furthermore, they also have green plus marks to show the regeneration effect.
abilities.quote: "Nice to see you! What can I get ya?" - Elliot

abilities.name: RUSH HOUR
abilities.desc:
Elliot builds momentum by healing teammates, converting it into a short burst of speed.
•Gains 1 charge whenever he heals another player (does not apply to other Elliots).
•Charges stack until the maximum amount of 3 is reached.
•Being within 85 studs of the killer turns the Rush Hour icon red, which means it will consume all charges if used within the Killer's vicinity.
•If used near the Killer (when the icon is red) Elliot uses those charges he gains for a stack of ⟦Speed|⟧ for 4 seconds.
•If within 85 studs of the Killer and with 2 or more charges, Elliot gains Exhausted II for 4 seconds after the speed boost runs out.
•Using the ability outside of a terror radius will not consume its charges nor give ⟦Exhausted|⟧.
•Starts the round with 1 charge.

•During **Rush Hour**, the on-hit speed boost is disabled, so taking damage will not grant additional speed.

characters.lead: Dusekkar is a Support Survivor, costing 600 Player Points. abilities.name: SPAWN PROTECTION
abilities.desc:
Dusekkar projects a protective barrier onto an ally, shielding them from harm at a distance.

The shield can be maintained for up to 3.5 seconds within a range of 95 studs. While active, the target gains ⟦Resistance|IV⟧, while Dusekkar is slowed by 30% during channeling.

**Channeling Mechanics:**

•The cursor must remain fixed on the target to sustain the shield.
•If line of sight is broken for more than 2 seconds, the shield collapses.

**Lethal Protection:**

•If the target would take lethal damage, the hit is completely negated.
•The shield immediately breaks upon preventing death.
•An XP popup appears explaining the interaction.

**Restrictions:**

•Cannot target anchored players, executing players, or another Dusekkar currently channeling protection.
•Failed casts do not trigger cooldown.
•Protected players cannot be targeted again for 30 seconds.

**Stacking Penalties**

•If three or more Dusekkars are shielding simultaneously, all shields shatter.
•All involved Dusekkars receive ⟦Blindness|III⟧ and ⟦Slowness|III⟧ for 6 seconds.

•Uses cursor targeting rather than visibility, allowing usage through walls.
•Can mitigate grab-based attacks if applied before anchoring occurs.
•Negating lethal damage does not grant the on-hit speed boost.
•⟦Resistance|IV⟧ has a short wind-up, but death prevention is instant.
•After **Spawn Protection** ends, there is a very brief timeframe where the ⟦Resistance|IV⟧ will linger.
•The -30% Movement Speed effect behaves as an invisible ⟦Slowness|III⟧, dispelling weaker ⟦Slowness|⟧ Effects.
abilities.quote: "Let be be finale of seem, seems to me." - Darkseed

abilities.name: PLASMA BEAM
abilities.desc:
Dusekkar channels volatile energy through their staff before releasing it in a focused beam.

After a 2-second windup, the beam fires up to 75 studs. During casting, Dusekkar's movement speed is reduced by 25%.

**On Hit:**

•**Killer:**
••Applies ⟦Slowness|I⟧ for 4 seconds but is reduced by 0.5 seconds per additional Dusekkar alive.
•• If the ⟦Slowness|⟧ duration is less than or equal to 0.5 seconds (at least 6 Dusekkars), then nothing happens.
•**Survivor:**
••Grants ⟦Speed|I⟧ for 3 seconds.
••Provides +25 overheal but is reduced by 2.5 per additional Dusekkar alive.
•• Overheal naturally decays at a rate of 1 overheal every 0.5 seconds (lasting 15 seconds if uninterrupted by outside means).

•Can only hit one Survivor but can strike both the Killer and a Survivor if aligned.
••Cannot affect anchored Killer, but can hit anchored Survivors.
•Passes through walls and objects.
•Overrides Noob's **Slateskin Potion** overheal (and vice versa).
•Overheal bleeds through damage, for example, if you have 15 overheal and you take 30 damage in one attack, you will instead take 15 damage.
••However, if the current overheal is greater than or equal to incoming damage, it fully absorbs it (e.g., **SK8** dealing no self-damage to Veeronica when she has at least 5 overheal).

He is known for his engineering abilities, able to deploy two of his signature devices: a sentry—which, when the Killer is in range, fires bullets that actively slow their movement speed—and a health regeneration dispenser, which gradually heals wounded Survivors nearby. abilities.name: SENTRY
abilities.desc:
Builderman takes 6 seconds to construct a **Sentry** in front of him.

**Sentries** have 30 Health and target nearby Killers, dealing damage and inflicting ⟦Slowness|II⟧ for 1 second. If Builderman is damaged while building a **Sentry**, it will be destroyed and the ability will be cancelled. If destroyed after built, will give 3$ and 12 EXP.

Builderman can only have 1 **Sentry** active at once, and will destroy any previously active **Sentry** you placed. **Sentries** have a target range of 65 studs, which decreases by 16% for every additional **Sentry** currently active. **Sentry** target range cannot go below 8 studs.

Other buildings cannot be built within 125 studs of a **Sentry**. **Sentry** does 0.7-0.6 damage per hit to the Killer.

•Builderman's structures are highlighted to himself and other survivors until they're completely destroyed.
•John Doe's Corrupt Energy grants on-hit buffs when hitting the Sentry.
•Builderman's structures are destroyed upon dying.
•Any players (including the user) standing in front of the Sentry will prevent it from shooting.
abilities.quote: "These sentries see your enemies so you don't have to!" - Roblox

abilities.name: DISPENSER
abilities.desc:
Builderman takes 6 seconds to construct a **Dispenser** infront of him.

**Dispensers** have 15 Health and heal in a 16-stud radius. If Builderman is damaged while building a **Dispenser**, it will be destroyed and the ability will be cancelled. Destroying it after finished building will give 3$ and 12 EXP.

Builderman can only have 1 **Dispenser** active at once, and will destroy any previously active **Dispenser** you placed. Dispensers heal 1HP/s, which decreases by 8% for every additional **Dispenser** currently active. **Dispenser** heal amount cannot go below 0.3HP/s.

Other buildings cannot be built within 60 studs of a **Dispenser**.

•Builderman's structures are highlighted to himself and other survivors until they're completely destroyed.
•John Doe's Corrupt Energy grants on-hit buffs when hitting the Dispenser.
•Builderman's structures are destroyed upon dying.
•Survivors inflicted with ⟦Undetectable|⟧ can still be healed by the Dispenser.
abilities.quote: "This is pretty much the best healing potion in any video game ever." - Roblox

abilities.desc:
Taph places a tripwire on the ground to hinder the Killer and alert nearby Survivors. Each Taph may have up to 3 tripwires active at a time; placing a fourth will automatically remove the oldest one, similar to John Doe's Digital Footprint.

When the Killer triggers a tripwire:
•All Survivors, including Taph see the Killer's aura for 8 seconds.
•The Killer is inflicted with ⟦Slowness|II⟧ for 4 seconds.

Additional info:
•Tripwires have 10 health and are destroyed if struck by the Killer.
•Has a 1.5s arming time.
•After placement, they gradually become less visible over 150 seconds.
•Each tripwire lasts forever.
•Stakes cannot be placed within 8 studs of one another.
•For every other Taph currently alive, negative effects inflicted by Tripwire will be shortened by 1.5s.

•
•**Subspace Tripmines** obstruct the tripwire's placement point, though this does not happen when done the other way around.
•Taph's traps are highlighted to Survivors who are near them until they get completely destroyed.
•Taph's traps are destroyed upon death.

abilities.name: SUBSPACE TRIPMINE
abilities.desc:
Taph arms a Subspace Tripmine and throws it onto the ground. Once placed, the mine becomes semi-invisible, briefly revealing itself every 13 seconds with a faint purple glow and sound cue.

When a Killer enters within 19 studs, the mine triggers after 0.5 seconds, inflicting ⟦Helpless|I⟧ for 3 seconds and ⟦Subspaced|III⟧ and ⟦Weakness|V⟧ for 6 seconds, which applies a dark pinkish visual filter and forcibly redirects the killer's camera for 6 seconds. If Taph is within the blast radius, they are also afflicted with the Tripmine's debuffs.

The Subspace Tripmine can be prematurely detonated if struck by a Killer's attack:

•If destroyed before activation, it inflicts a weaker ⟦Subspaced|I⟧ with no ⟦Helpless|I⟧ or ⟦Weakness|V⟧.
•If left untouched for 50 seconds, it automatically explodes.
•If the mine successfully detonates on a Killer, its cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.
•For every other Taph currently alive, negative effects inflicted by Subspace Tripmine will be shortened by 2s.

•If a **Subspace Tripmine** detonates during a kill animation, and the killer is caught in its blast radius, they will still be inflicted with ⟦Subspaced|3⟧, but without ⟦Helpless|⟧. However, if this happens to Taph, they will still be inflicted with ⟦Helpless|⟧.
•⟦Subspaced|⟧'s high contrast effect become darker instead of brighter if epilepsy mode is enabled. Additionally, it silences the killer's chase theme to those inflicted by it.
•Taph's traps are highlighted to survivors who are near them until they get completely destroyed.
•Taph's traps are destroyed upon death.

characters.description: An excitable little machine with one very important directive: help! Equipped with a built-in radar and bursts of restorative energy, Helperbot keeps their teammates informed, protected, and ready for action. characters.lead: Helperbot is a Support Survivor and the 13th survivor added to FORSAKEN. Introduced in Update 5.3.0 on October 16, 2026. They are based on the "HelperBot" character in 'Welcome to Roblox Building'.
characters.title: https://forsaken.fntduserguide.com/img/helperbot-title.webp

abilities.name: RADAR
abilities.desc:
Helperbot periodically reveals nearby unfinished generators and items to all Survivors. Objects within 100 studs are highlighted for 3s, with a scan occurring every 12s

When another Survivor uses an ability, their aura is revealed to Helperbot for 3s, colored according to their remaining health.
abilities.quote: "The right tools are never far away. Sometimes you just need a little help finding them." - Builderman

abilities.name: PULSE
abilities.desc:
After a 2s windup Helperbot releases an expanding pulse that grants ⟦Regeneration|⟧ and ⟦Resistance|⟧ to Survivors it reaches, including themselves.

Helperbot starts with one charge and can store up to three. Charges earned through Inspire improve Pulse's radius and buffs. All stored charges are consumed when the pulse is released.

Level 0

Base Radius: 30 studs

⟦Regeneration|I⟧ for 4s.

⟦Resistance|I⟧ for 4s.

Level 1

Base Radius: +10% compared to the base radius (33)

⟦Regeneration|I⟧ for 5s.

⟦Resistance|I⟧ for 5s.

Level 2

Base Radius: +20% compared to the base radius (36)

⟦Regeneration|I⟧ for 6s.

⟦Resistance|I⟧ for 6s.

Level 3

Base Radius: +30% compared to the base radius (39)

⟦Regeneration|I⟧ for 7s.

⟦Resistance|I⟧ for 7s.

Each additional Helperbot reduces the buffs' durations by 1s, to a minimum of 1s before the following modifier.

Other Helperbot characters receiving the pulse receive 50% of those durations. This reduction does not apply to the caster.

Helperbot is slowed down by 10% during the windup of this ability.
abilities.quote: "A good repair gets you moving. A great one gets the whole team moving." - Builderman

abilities.name: INSPIRE
abilities.desc:
After a 0.75s windup Helperbot creates an inspiring aura that follows them for 10s. Other Survivors within 14 studs receive Haste V, accelerating their ability cooldowns.

Each Survivor who stays inside Inspire's area for 5.5 seconds grants Helperbot one Pulse charge, up to three stored charges<. Each Survivor can contribute once per cast.

Leaving the area gradually drains that Survivor's unfinished charge progress. Returning resumes it from whatever remains. Completed charges are not lost by leaving the area.

Each additional Helperbot reduces the applied Haste by one level, down to a minimum of Haste I
abilities.quote: "Keep encouraging each other. Nobody builds something great all on their own." - Builderman

characters.name: Slasher
characters.description: Seeking revenge on the world that wronged him, the Slasher stalks this domain with an old chainsaw and an eager intent to snap the metal. No one cared about the young child in a world that didn’t love him. No one cared about the soldier’s body, violently brought back to life through the Necrobloxicon. They arise now as walking death, trudged forward by the echo of her gentle voice. They all created the Slasher. They all will pay.
characters.lead: Slasher is a FORSAKEN-original Killer and one of the eight playable Killers. He is one of two Killers available for free to all players, automatically unlocked when joining the game for the very first time. Added in Update 3.1.0 on August 30, 2025, he is a redesign of his predecessor, Jason, created due to copyright concerns. Slasher specializes in stealth and chases, using his signature machete to hunt down Survivors.
characters.title: https://forsaken.fntduserguide.com/img/slasher-title.webp

abilities.name: FINAL CHAPTER
abilities.desc: Slasher gains ⟦Resistance IV|⟧ for 10 seconds when stunned. This has no effect on the duration or potency of incoming effects, only their damage, and does not change in longevity with different different stun immunity durations. Furthermore, it doesn't affect the damage of the attack that stunned Slasher, only damage following it.
abilities.quote: This ability has no official name nor displayed in-game. This passive will be called Final Chapter for ease of referencing.

abilities.name: SLASH
abilities.desc:
Slasher performs a basic slash with his machete after a 0.2s windup. The effects are as follows:
•Deals 20 damage.
•Inflicts ⟦Bleeding|I⟧ for 5 seconds (totaling ~28 damage over time).
•Windup: **0.2s**
•Linger: **0.25s**
•Length: **7.5 studs**
•If used while **ENRAGED**, Slasher lunges 19 studs forward and the damage increases to 25 by 25% (33 with ⟦Bleeding|I⟧).
•Can hit multiple Survivors at once.

•Hitting a Survivor while ⟦Bleeding|I⟧ is still active will raise the effect to ⟦Bleeding|II⟧. The timer does not reset.
•This attack can hit multiple people at once.
abilities.quote: "Make them remember!" - Mother

abilities.name: BEHEAD
abilities.desc:
Slasher winds up a heavy horizontal swing aimed at the target's head. The effects are as follows:
•If the player is moving, Slasher will lunge forward in the direction they are facing, lunging further at higher speeds.
•Deals 25 damage and inflicts ⟦Helpless|⟧ for 8s.
•Damage increases to 35 by 75% if **ENRAGED**.
•Regardless of whether the swing lands, Slasher is very briefly immobilized and also inflicted with ⟦Slowness|I⟧ for 2s.
•As compared to Slash, the hitbox of the attack is wider but smaller vertically. If there are multiple Survivors within the hitbox of Behead, they will all be hit by it.

•Windup: 0.45s
•Killing a Survivor with Behead or using Behead during Gashing Wound's Hit endlag does not apply the ⟦Slowness|⟧ penalty to Slasher.
abilities.quote: "No place to hide." - Mother

abilities.name: GASHING WOUND
abilities.desc:
Slasher slices forward and unleashes a relentless chain of attacks with his machete and chainsaw. The effects are as follows:
•Begins with two machete strikes, each dealing 20% of the total damage.
•Leads into a slash with the chainsaw, dealing 20% of the total damage.
•Follows with a chainsaw stab, dealing 10% of the total damage, twice.
•Finishes by kicking the Survivor to the ground, causing a brief ragdoll effect and dealing the remaining 20% of the damage.
•Default total damage is 50, but if **ENRAGED**, damage is increased to 70.
•Can strike multiple survivors within the hitbox.
••All hits dealt after the first machete slash have significantly smaller hitboxes.
••Only locks one survivor into the animation.

•Windup: 0.33s
•On hit, Slasher is immune to stuns for the entire animation and for a lingering 1.5s after he is able to move again.
•Slasher is able to move during the initial 0.1s of Gashing Wound's wind-up.
•Slasher is immobilized for 4.5 seconds after using Gashing Wound, regardless of whether the move hits.
abilities.quote: "It'll be easier for you than it was for him." - Mother

abilities.name: RAGING PACE
abilities.desc:
Upon activation, Slasher's left eye begins to glow with a red flare as he enters his **ENRAGED** state. The effects are as follows:
•Speed becomes **19**.
•All of Slasher's other abilities become enhanced, gaining reduced cooldowns, increased damage, and, for **Slash** and **Behead**, a forward lunge. Full details are listed under each ability.
•The aura of the nearest survivor is revealed for 14s, lingering for the full duration even if **ENRAGED** ends beforehand.
•Slasher is granted ⟦Invincibility|⟧ for the entire duration, negating any stun or negative status effects. This lingers for 1.5s after Slasher exits the state.
•Sprinting is disabled.
•Stamina gradually caps at **70** over 6.5s. The cap is removed once **ENRAGED** ends.
•**ENRAGED** lasts for about 14s, and can be roughly tracked through the cooldown (it ends when the cooldown reaches 16). It immediately ends if Slasher uses another ability.
•While **ENRAGED**, Slasher is immune to all attacks, including melee, ranged, and Taph's tripwire.
••**Exceptions:** Taph's **Subspace Tripmine** and Builderman's **Sentry** bypass this immunity. The **Subspace Tripmine** still inflicts ⟦Subspaced|3⟧ when Slasher enters its blast radius (though not its ⟦Helpless|⟧ or ⟦Weakness|⟧ effect), while Builderman's **Sentry** can still hit Slasher.
••Slasher gains stun immunity only 0.3s after using the move. Under normal circumstances, this immunity ends before any of Slasher's attack animations (or the Raging Pace end-lag), so it only applies if a Survivor attack is attempted during the start of such an animation.
abilities.quote: "Kill them!" - Mother

characters.name: John Doe
characters.caption: DON'T PLAY ROBLOX ON MARCH 18TH?!?!
characters.description: The defunct code of the early days of Roblox courses through their body, consuming his mind as he now focuses on one thing: to kill everyone in his path. An unstoppable force entering the round with a strategical mindset, he's able to set traps, summon walls to back survivors into a corner, and leave behind a faint trail that damages those who step on it.
characters.lead: John Doe is a **Zoner/Trapper/Attrition** Killer centered around map control, tracking, and restricting Survivor movement through corruption-based attacks. Widely considered one of the most, if not the most, technical Killers in the game with an extremely high skill ceiling, his playstyle revolves around trapping and cornering Survivors into vulnerable positions rather than relying solely on direct chase power. Unlike most Killers, his abilities are rarely used for direct kills. Instead, they focus on blocking escape routes and loops, gradually wearing Survivors down until he can finish them off with **Slash**. His signature ⟦Corrupted|⟧ effect is applied throughout nearly his entire kit, constantly pressuring Survivors over time.
characters.title: https://forsaken.fntduserguide.com/img/john-doe-title.webp

abilities.name: TILL DEATH DO US PART
abilities.desc: Under the influence of either The Spectre or John Doe's corruption, John Doe is blocked from seeing Jane Doe's face, as it is covered by a glitchy black square.
abilities.quote: This passive has no official name nor displayed in-game. This passive will be called TILL DEATH DO US PART for ease of referencing.

abilities.name: NATURAL MALEVOLENCE
abilities.desc:
For every step John Doe takes, a trail of corruption spreads behind him, steadily chipping away at the health of any survivor unfortunate enough to step into it. The effects are as follows:

•The trail extends 48 studs before begginging to close in as John Doe continues walking.
•Survivors who step on the trail are inflicted with ⟦Corrupted|II⟧ for 3 seconds, dealing 7.5 damage-over-time.
abilities.quote: "We're dedicated to building a fun, safe environment where kids of all ages can power their imagination on Roblox." - Roblox

abilities.name: UNSTOPPABLE
abilities.desc:
If John Doe is ⟦Stunned|⟧ while activating **Corrupt Energy** or **404 Error**, the stun time is weakened, and John Doe gains a ⟦Speed|⟧ boost to catch up. The effects are as follows:

•The stun duration is capped at 2 seconds.
•When the stun ends, John Doe unleashes a loud roar and gains ⟦Speed|I⟧ for 3 seconds, increased by 1 additional second for every Sentinel currently alive.
•The cooldown of the ability that triggered **Unstoppable** is reduced by 50% (**Corrupt Energy** is reduced to 9 seconds, while **404 Error** is reduced to 10 seconds).
•While Unstoppable Speed boost is active, the duration of all incoming negative status effects are reduced by 50%.
abilities.quote: "Consider this myth busted." - Roblox

abilities.name: SLASH
abilities.desc:
For the primary attack, John Doe raises his arm and slashes down in front of him with his claws. The stats are as follows:

•Damage: **28**
•Windup: **0.35s**
•Linger: **0.25s**
•Length: **7.5 studs**
abilities.quote: "For many years, there has been lore circulating around John Doe and ████ Doe within the community." - Roblox

abilities.name: CORRUPT ENERGY
abilities.desc:
John Doe punches his corrupted arm into the ground and, when he pulls it out, a wall of spikes emerge in front of him. The effects are as follows:

• Summons 31 spikes that last 14 seconds each.
• Survivors hit directly take 11 damage.
• John Doe gains ⟦Speed|I⟧ for 7 seconds if a Survivor is hit.
• Survivors standing on the spikes are inflicted with ⟦Corrupted|II⟧ for 5 seconds, dealing 12.5 damage.
• Each survivor can be hit a maximum of 2 times, for a total of 22 damage.
abilities.quote: "This year, we've decided that it's time to shed some light about these accounts." - Roblox

abilities.name: RETRACT
abilities.desc: by re-using Corrupt Energy during spikes lifetime John Doe will pull the spikes back to the ground.
abilities.quote: "This year, we've decided that it's time to shed some light about these accounts." - Roblox

abilities.name: DIGITAL FOOTPRINT
abilities.desc:
John Doe stomps on the ground three times, with the third summoning a large shadow beneath him, functioning as a trap. The effects are as follows:
•A maximum of 3 traps can exist at any given time.
•Each trap lasts indefinitely.
•John Doe has his traps permanently highlighted to him.

**When stepped in by a Survivor:**

•The trap disappears as the survivor triggers it.
•John Doe gains ⟦Speed|I⟧ for 10 seconds.
•The survivor is inflicted with ⟦Slowness|II⟧ and ⟦Corrupted|I⟧ for 10 seconds, for 19 damage over time.
•Both John Doe and the survivor have their auras revealed to each other.

•All **Digital Footprints** can be heard by both Survivors and Killers (aka John Doe) within 90 studs of the trap.
abilities.quote: "John Doe and ████ Doe are two of Roblox's earliest accounts, as seen by their low user IDs here." - Roblox

abilities.name: 404 ERROR
abilities.desc:
John Doe's corrupted arm pulsates twice, before revealing the auras of all living survivors to him for **6** seconds.

•John Doe is heavily slowed down while using **404 Error**. Additionally, he cannot sprint.
abilities.quote: "Authentic John Doe and ████ Doe accounts pose no danger to your Roblox account." - Roblox

abilities.name: HALLUCINATIONS
abilities.desc:

•Survivors with any Hallucination level have their aura revealed to Noli. The darker the highlight, the more intense the effect is.

•At ⟦Hallucination|I⟧, the survivor's timer becomes unreadable.
•At ⟦Hallucination|II⟧, fake healing objects such as a pizza or dispenser spawn to distract survivors.
•At ⟦Hallucination|III⟧, a hostile mirage of Noli appears and attacks the survivor. Mirages don't deal damage, even if they appear so. Your health bar will appear to be "depleting", but you will stay alive.

•Hallucinations received are dependent on the Survivors currently being used in the round.
•⟦Hallucination|I⟧ can list an incorrect amount of generators completed. This also works for other Quests like Jane Doe's.
•Can also play Layer 1 of Noli's chase theme despite Noli being nowhere nearby.
•If there is a Dusekkar in the round, a survivor may hallucinate receiving "Spawn Protection." if the survivor looks over at the direction the protection is coming from at all, Noli's face will rapidly charge towards them, blurring their vision for a brief moment upon contact.
•Noli mirages do not have footsteps.
•Noli mirage's voidstar does not disappear when using abilities.
•Noli mirages can be killed by any attack that can cast a hitbox, causing ⟦Hallucination|⟧ to wear off, including Dusekkar's Plasma Beam and Jane Doe's Crystal Pitch.
••Veeronica's **Bumper Channel** Broadcast does not kill it, due to it not passively casting hitboxes (one casts only upon direct impact with a real killer).
•Noli mirages cannot interrupt actions or effects (e.g. using a medkit, repairing a generator, healing over time).
abilities.quote: "O, that way madness lies."

abilities.name: PRANKSTER
abilities.desc:
When the round starts, Noli spawns fake generators in any place where all the 5 real generators could have spawned, but didn't.
•Completing a Fake Generator grants one Hallucination stack.
•Fully completing a Fake Generator instantly grants **⟦Hallucination|III⟧**.
•Fake Generators give no progress or points.
•Survivors can identify Fake Generators by:
••A considerably noticeable delay on the completion UI bar after completing a puzzle
••Glitching sounds when nearby.
••Incorrect puzzle complete message.
••Incorrect XP or money amounts.
••There will be a "!" at the end of the text.
••Physical generator progress color will be an off shade of green.
••A puzzle number gets skipped.
••Incorrect currency. (+¢5, +¥5...)
••If the time doesn't decrease after completing a puzzle.
••Money symbol after amount of cash earned. (+5$ instead of +$5)
••Electrical wires on generator model appear to be stained or torn with black (guaranteed for every fake generator).

• Survivor doesn't gain any malice upon completing a puzzle on a Fake Generator, despite being displayed properly on its exp/money gain notification.
• Veeronica's battery doesn't charge upon completing a Fake Generator.
• Veeronica's graffiti cannot be placed on a Fake Generator.
abilities.quote: "Art ignorant of what thou art."

abilities.name: STAB
abilities.desc:
Noli uses his Shadow Tendril to stab forwards.

•Damage: **25**
•Windup: **0.35s**
•Linger: **0.25s**
•Length: **8 studs**
•Offset: **+0.5 studs**

•Hitting a Survivor removes all stacks of ⟦Hallucination|⟧.
• Unlike other Killers, Noli's hitbox spawns 0.5 studs farther away from his position, making his reach effectively be 8.5 studs.
abilities.quote: "Our revels now are ended."

abilities.name: VOID RUSH
abilities.desc:
On tap/hold, Noli prepares a rush for 1 second (which can be canceled anytime), charging forward for 3.5s to strike survivors. Once hitting a survivor without ⟦Hallucination|⟧, Noli can quickly perform another rush after 0.85s by pressing the Void Rush key again or cancel it by letting it time out after 2s.
•Hitting a survivor deals 10 damage and applies ⟦Hallucination|II⟧. Hitting multiple targets will also amplify slam damage by 3.5.
•Survivors with ⟦Hallucination|II⟧ or higher are slammed into the ground, taking 10 + 30 + 3.5 × re-rushes damage and ending the move.
••For example, if Noli performs a single rush against a survivor with ⟦Hallucination|II⟧, they take a minimum of 43.5 damage (10 + 30 + 3.5).
•Turn rate is heavily increased during the first 1.5 seconds of the rush.
•Noli can hold Sprint before a re-rush to briefly boost himself.

If Noli crashes into any obstacle or if Noli cancels the dash while it is active, they are heavily slowed down for ~1.5s.
The rush ends early if Noli is stunned, crashes into a wall or releases the Void Rush key.

Noli is unable to regenerate stamina for the duration of the rush.

•The text below the charge meter changes depending on certain conditions, sometimes having humorous messages:
••Charging rush: "Charge Void Rush by holding down"
••Canceling charge: "you didn't charge it long enough <:(("
••During rush: "Release the Void Rush key to cancel"
••Hitting a target without ⟦Hallucination|⟧: "Hit the Void Rush key again to charge again!"
••Slamming: "hell yeah >:)"
••Rush timeout: "too slow"
••Colliding with an obstacle: "owwwww;("
••Cancelling rush: "Awww:("
••Re-rush window timeout: "ok...:("
•Rushing into Builderman's buildings will end the rush prematurely with the dash message "PROPERTY DAMAGE".
•Void Rush can rush through Taph's Tripwire and Subspace Tripmine.
•Void Rush's first hit and slam deal damage to all survivors in its hitbox, although its first hit only applies ⟦Hallucination|II⟧ to the survivor with the highest Hit Priority.
•Hitting someone, regardless of their ⟦Hallucination|⟧ stack who has 10 HP or less will simply kill them without slamming, allowing Noli to continue rushing. Although, if the victim is inflicted with ⟦Hallucination|II⟧ or higher already, Void Rush will slam them instead on random occasions, which is most likely a bug.
•Void Rush's slam removes all stacks of ⟦Hallucination|⟧.
•Void Rush detects a crash only if Noli's velocity is too low (or in other words, if they're too slow). This is the reason, for example, why you can utilise wallsliding, but also why Void Rush is stopped on slippery surfaces or stopped easier if you're currently slowed by any source.
abilities.quote: "Which pierces so that it assaults."

abilities.name: NOVA
abilities.desc:
Noli throws his Voidstar forward after a 0.7 second windup.
•The projectile travels forward; hitting a survivor or wall causes a spherical implosion that pulls survivors toward the blast and deals **15** damage. Also has a slight slowing effect that decays the further you are from the implosion's original impact.
•Hitting the floor causes the Voidstar to reduce the hitbox of the explosion. Manually exploding the Voidstar by using the move again will also decrease the hitbox.
•Cooldown will only initiate after the Void Star detonates.

•If the user gets stunned during the windup, it will not throw the Void Star and the cooldown will be 0.3s.
••When stunned, the Void Star itself will be thrown but not with it's hitbox.
•Nova's explosion does not remove ⟦Hallucination|⟧ stacks.
abilities.quote: "Thou art inclined to sleep; 'tis a good dullness."

abilities.name: OBSERVANT
abilities.desc:
Noli enters a stance, highlighting all generators and displaying a mirage above them as a warning.
•After 1.45 second windup, Noli can teleport to a selected generator.
•Survivors more than 20/50/100 studs away receive **⟦Hallucination|I/II/III⟧** respectively.
•Stunning Noli during windup or stance cancels the move.
•Noli gains stun immunity after they teleports.
•At the start of the game, Observant is placed on a 25 second cooldown.
•The ability can be canceled by recasting it during selection.

•Getting stunned while attempting to teleport will cause Observant to go on a 15s cooldown. However, getting stunned after selecting a generator will cause Observant to go on full cooldown instead.
•Cannot select generators within 50 studs.
•Observant actually starts the round off on full cooldown, but appears to be lowered due to the intro animation.
•Teleporting next to a survivor 19 studs or less away will not give **⟦Hallucination|⟧** to the survivor.
•Observant's ingame description is incorrect; saying Observant starts the game off on halved cooldown.
abilities.quote: "Mine enemies are all knit up in their distractions."

characters.name: 1x1x1x1
characters.caption: Then, in a footnote, mentions the evil 1x1x1x1.”
characters.description: The physical manifestation of pure malice, hatred, and negativity himself; the one who despises no one else more than the former admin, Shedletsky. With the Dæmonshank in their hands, they can summon beings of rot from the deceased, as well as target survivors from afar, poisoning them in the process.
characters.lead: 1x1x1x1 is a **Zoner** Killer, applying constant pressure to Survivors at close-to-medium range. While they have the lowest base run speed, their abilities allow them to use piercing projectiles to stun, relocate, and damage survivors. Outside of their projectiles, 1x1x1x1 is able to close in on survivors through on-demand, brief speed boosts from **Unstable Eye**, catching up to the Survivor with their marginally higher sprint speed. After successfully killing a survivor, 1x1x1x1 can reanimate their corpse to create autonomous minions serving as traps with **Rejuvenate the Rotten.**

abilities.name: SLASH
abilities.desc:
1x1x1x1 swings their sword in front of them. The effects are as follows:
•Deals 20 damage on hit.
•Inflicts ⟦Glitched|I⟧ for 5 seconds.
•Inflicts ⟦Poisoned|1⟧ for 5 seconds.

•**Total Damage:** 28
••**Slash:** 20
••**Status Effects:** 8

•Windup: **0.4s**
•Linger: **0.25s**
•Length: **7.5 studs**
abilities.quote: "Turns out they fixed nothing but the floating plates and jump pads, and the exploits in this game are insane." - Concerned SFOTH Player

abilities.name: MASS INFECTION
abilities.desc:
1x1x1x1 chains themself to black orbs and, after a 1.7-second windup, performs a horizontal split attack with two swords, creating a sharp shockwave audible to all survivors regardless of their distance from 1x1x1x1. The effects are as follows:
•The shockwave lasts 6 seconds and travels at 104 studs per second.
••This results in a total range of 624 studs.
•Deals a universal 30 damage on hit.
••Deals an additional 10 damage against targets inflicted with ⟦Glitched|⟧.

•**If a Survivor is inside the "up close" radius:**
••Inflicts ⟦Glitched|II⟧ for 5 seconds.
••Inflicts ⟦Poisoned|V⟧} for 3 seconds.
••Instantly inflicts an additional 25 damage.

•**If a Survivor is hit by the shockwave:**
••Inflicts ⟦Glitched|I⟧ for 5 seconds.
••Inflicts ⟦Poisoned|I⟧ for 5 seconds.

•**Total Damage:**
••**Up Close:** 77
•••**Universal:** 30
•••**Melee:** 25
•••**⟦Poisoned|⟧ Bonus:** 12
•••**⟦Glitched|⟧ Bonus:** 10
••**Not Up Close:** 38/48
•••**Universal:** 30
•••**⟦Poisoned|⟧ Bonus:** 8
•••**⟦Glitched|⟧ Bonus:** 10 (may not be active)

•**Audio Cue:**
••The windup of this attack can be heard by all living players.

•Survivors hit by **Mass Infection** have their aura revealed to 1x1x1x1 for 12 seconds.
•The attack has separate hitboxes for long range and close range. The close-range hitbox deals significantly less damage but extends to behind 1x1x1x1 and applies more intense effects.
•Survivors hit by **Mass Infection** at close range receive a significant speed boost, with a duration of about three seconds.
•**Mass Infection** cannot kill zombies summoned by **Rejuvenate the Rotten**.
•1x1x1x1's momentum is not immediately halted upon using **Mass Infection**, allowing them to move slightly during the wind-up.
•Movement is immediately restored after releasing the shockwave.
•During the windup, 1x1x1x1's camera slightly zooms in and a green vignette appears over its edges.
••When using multiple **Mass Infections** at once while cooldowns are disabled, these effects are cumulative with each other.
abilities.quote: "Blame ████." - Roblox Admin

abilities.name: ENTANGLEMENT
abilities.desc:
1x1x1x1 throws their sword forward following a 0.75-second windup. The effects are as follows:
•The projectile lasts 1 second and travels at 125 studs per second.
••This results in a total range of 125 studs.

**Effects on Hit Survivors:**
••Deals 10 damage on hit.
••Aura is revealed to 1x1x1x1 for 12 seconds.
••Inflicts ⟦Helpless|⟧ and ⟦Glitched|II⟧ for 6 seconds.
••Inflicts ⟦Slowness|X⟧ for 0.85s-1.25s (Depending on distance).
••Pulls the survivor toward 1x1x1x1.
•••Pull strength is increased by 75% on survivors afflicted with ⟦Glitched|⟧.

•**Entanglement** covers the Survivor's screen with 12 cosmetic pop-ups upon hit.
•1x1x1x1's momentum is not immediately halted upon using **Entanglement**, allowing them to move slightly during the wind-up.
•**Entanglement** can kill zombies summoned by **Rejuvenate the Rotten**.
••When hitting a zombie, **Entanglement** deals 100 damage and will instantly kill it, instead of its ordinary 10 damage.
abilities.quote: "I joined him in Crossroads, and it started raining heads saying things along the lines of 'he's coming back!' and '1x1x1x1 is coming for you!' and the likes." - Roblox Admin

abilities.name: UNSTABLE EYE
abilities.desc:
1x1x1x1 digs into their glaring red eye after a 1.5 second startup, tearing it opens to unleash its power. The effects are as follows:
•Reveals the auras of all living Survivors for 8 seconds.
•Grants ⟦Speed|II⟧ for 1.5 seconds.
•Inflicts ⟦Blindness|III⟧ for 7 seconds.
•Highlights Survivors based on health along with making the screen red.

•At the start of the round, this ability starts on a halved (12.5s) cooldown.

•Begins stamina regeneration immediately on use, completely ignoring any delay.
•Speed effect is stackable: for example, if 1x1x1x1 kills a minion and then uses **Unstable Eye**, they gain ⟦Speed|III⟧ (albeit for 1.5s). The ⟦Speed|⟧ that is stackable is capped at ⟦Speed|X⟧, however this is impossible to see in normal gameplay.
•• Strangely, the ⟦Blindness|⟧ effect can be stacked too, with a cap of ⟦Blindness|III⟧
•**Unstable Eye** can also be heard by survivors within 400 studs of 1x1x1x1, although it is very quiet from a far place.
•1x1x1x1 can sprint 0.35s after the windup.
•1x1x1x1 can move with walk speed during the windup.
abilities.quote: "I see you."

abilities.name: REJUVENATE THE ROTTEN
abilities.desc:
1x1x1x1 stabs themselves with their swords and pulls them out, resurrecting any players they have killed in the form of rotten zombies that act as uncontrollable but loyal minions. The effects are as follows:
•Minions wander aimlessly upon spawning.
•They target players within a 20 stud distance.
•They lose focus if the distance exceeds 30 studs.
•Minions have 25 health and inflict ⟦Poisoned|1⟧, ⟦Glitched|I⟧ for 8 seconds on contact with survivors, also reveal their aura for 8 seconds. ⟦Glitched|⟧ survivors take 5 damage, but survivors may only be killed by the minion if the survivor is inflicted with ⟦Glitched|⟧

•**Interaction with** 1x1x1x1**:**
••Although loyal, minions can be killed by 1x1x1x1.
••They can't be killed with Mass Infection.
••Killing a zombie grants ⟦Speed|I⟧ for 8 seconds and the effect cannot stack.
••This ability starts with 0 charges and gains 1 charge per kill, up to a maximum of 1 charge.

•Windup: ~3-4s
•Zombies emit green auras that are visible only to 1x1x1x1 while they are alive.
•Zombies spawn exactly where the player died, even if the body was flung.
•Zombies can damage their target multiple times, but can only kill when the ⟦Glitched|⟧ effect is applied.
•This ability currently has no endlag, meaning 1x1x1x1’s movement speed is restored immediately after the windup ends.
abilities.quote: "He sent me a message, telling me he had something to demonstrate." - Roblox Admin

characters.name: Guest 666
characters.caption: A kind of beast never before encountered.
characters.description: "Cursed with their name from the moment of their existence, he had managed to find solace in Noob. Someone who saw them for they were inside, but that ideal reality would not last. Guest 666 will viciously rip and tear through any obstacle in her way, feasting on the bloodshed and carnage to empower his abilities."
characters.lead: Guest 666 is a **Snowball/Attrition** Killer who excels at punishing mistakes, applying constant pressure, and using precision over brute force. Survivors afflicted with ⟦Hemorrhage|1⟧ drop **Blood Orbs**, which Guest 666 can collect to build Blood and activate **Blood Hunt**. Their main ability, **Carving Slash**, consists of a 20-damage slash that can hit multiple targets. If Guest 666 has at least 10 Blood, holding M1 triggers **Eviscerate**, a lunge that deals 10 damage, propels them forward, and inflicts the hit Survivor with ⟦Hemorrhage|1⟧ and grants them 15 Blood. This final phase applies ⟦Hemorrhage|I⟧, lasting up to 120 seconds (removable by another Survivor), gradually reducing the target's maximum HP. Success with **Carving Slash** rewards Blood and cooldown reduction, while missing can briefly slow Guest 666.
