abilities.name: MANIC FIXATION
abilities.desc:
Guest 666 gains movement speed when running toward or being within 30 studs Survivors highlighted by their abilities. The effects are as follows:
•Gradually gains up to 7% speed while running toward or being within 30 studs of survivors highlighted by **Infernal Cry** or **Blood Rush.**
•If the highlighted Survivor is not in chase, the speed bonus increases up to 12% (with the 10% extra speed boost when not within 85 studs of a survivor, it's effectively 22%).
•Speed is lost once Guest 666 stops moving toward the highlighted Survivor while outside of 30 studs, exits the 30 stud range while not moving toward them or the highlight runs out.

•The passive relies on when a Survivor is supposed to be highlighted, regardless of their current Status Effects, meaning that if a highlight is cleansed through gaining ⟦Undetectable|⟧, the visual highlight disappears, but the speed boost can still be gained for the remainder of the highlight's initial duration.
abilities.quote: "Have you not heard the legend of Guest 666?" - Random Robloxian

abilities.name: HELLFORGED WILL
abilities.desc: Guest 666 reduces the duration of non-self-inflicted negative status effects and stuns by 25% (increases to 50% while Blood Hunt is active).
abilities.quote: "I tried my hardest, but they were unstoppable." - ████

abilities.name: BLOODHOUND
abilities.desc:
**Hemorrhage**

Many of Guest 666's attacks inflict ⟦Hemorrhage|⟧, a status effect that prevents full healing and causes Survivors to drop Blood Orbs. The effects are as follows:
•While afflicted with ⟦Hemorrhage|⟧, vines begin to cover the Survivor's health bar.
•Any health covered by vines cannot be healed.
•⟦Hemorrhage|⟧ can be removed by another Survivor, but they must interact with you first by clicking.
•Medkits can remove ⟦Hemorrhage|⟧, but do not restore vine-covered health.

**Blood Orbs**

Survivors affected by ⟦Hemorrhage|⟧ will occasionally drop Blood Orbs, which Guest 666 can collect to empower their abilities. The effects are as follows:
•Each Blood Orb grants Guest 666 15 Blood on contact.
•Blood Orbs drop faster when the Survivor is sprinting and slower during a chase.
••Sprinting: 1 Blood Orb every 10 seconds.
••Chase: 1 Blood Orb every 35 seconds.
••Sprinting in Chase: 1 Blood Orb every 25 seconds.
•Guest 666 starts with 0 Blood and has a maximum of 200 Blood.
•Collecting Blood Orbs reduces all active cooldowns by 3 seconds per orb.
•Killing a Survivor grants 30 Blood. If the kill was caused by **Demonic Pursuit**, it grants 50 Blood instead.
•Blood Orbs can always be collected during LMS, regardless of Guest 666's current Blood Meter.

**Combat**

•Guest 666's attacks are devastating and can hit multiple targets at once.
•The effects are as follows:
•All of Guest 666's attacks hit multiple players simultaneously.
abilities.quote: "I know you hate that name... so how about Sixer instead?' - ████

abilities.name: SENSE OF FEAR
abilities.desc: Guest 666's aura revealing abilities from **Infernal Cry**, **Blood Hunt**, and **Blood Rush** will instead apply ⟦Marked|⟧ rather than the normal yellow highlight. Due to this, Survivors with ⟦Undetectable|⟧ will be bypassed and their aura will still be revealed to Guest 666. ⟦Subspaced|⟧ can disable the aura read for the duration, but it'll come back once the effect has worn off. However, if a survivor gains ⟦Undetectable|⟧ WHILE having ⟦Marked|⟧, it will actually cleanse ⟦Marked|⟧, effectively cancelling the aura reveal for the affected survivor.
abilities.quote: This ability has no official name nor displayed in-game. This passive will be called Sense of Fear for ease of referencing.

abilities.name: CARVING SLASH
abilities.desc:
Guest 666's main attack allows them to slash at Survivors. If Guest 666 has at least 10 Blood, they can follow up with **Eviscerate** by holding down the primary attack button. The effects are as follows:
•Performs a basic slashing attack.
•Each slash can hit multiple Survivors simultaneously.
•Each slash deals 20 damage.
•Each successful hit grants 10 Blood.

•Windup: **0.3s**
•Linger: **0.25s**
•Length: **7.25 studs**

• Unlike other Killers, Guest 666's hitbox is taller than the rest due to their size.
abilities.quote:
‎"The legend says that Guest 666 could use admin commands
 and stuff... pretty gnarly..." - Random Robloxian

abilities.name: EVISCERATE
abilities.desc:
Guest 666 will lunge forward and bite down using **Eviscerate**. Any Survivors hit by this attack will take damage and suffer a status effect. The effects are as follows:
•Deals 10 damage to any Survivor hit.
•Applies ⟦Hemorrhage|⟧ on hit
•Costs 10 Blood to use.
•Grants 15 Blood and reduces Eviscerate's cooldown by 50% on a successful hit.
•If Guest 666 fails to hit a Survivor, they are afflicted with ⟦Slowness|I⟧ for 2.5 seconds. Hitting this halves the duration.

•Windup: **0.4s**
•Linger: **0.25s**
•Length: **7 studs**
abilities.quote: ‎"Have you ever tried this? Give it a bite!' - ████

abilities.name: DEMONIC PURSUIT
abilities.desc:
**Demonic Pursuit** is a charge- and mobility-based ability. On use, Guest 666 crouches and becomes transparent until the button is released. The ability can be held or toggled to charge longer, which increases damage and speed. A red arrow visualizer appears and can be aimed upward.

**Pinning a Survivor**

If Guest 666 makes contact with a Survivor while airborne or within the first 0.8 seconds of a leap, they will pin them down. When a Survivor is successfully pinned:
•Guest 666 slashes the Survivor 5 times.
•Inflicts 1 stack of ⟦Hemorrhage|⟧
•Throws the Survivor to the left and roars.
••Changing direction mid-leap does not alter the throw direction.

**Damage Values**

Each slash deals damage depending on how long the ability was charged:
•5.2 / 6.6 / 8.0 damage per hit
•Total: 26 / 33 / 40 damage
Successfully landing the ability grants 20 Blood, and killing a Survivor with this ability grants 50 Blood.

**Blood Hunt Bonus**

During Blood Hunt, this ability deals bonus damage based on how long the Survivor has been afflicted with ⟦Hemorrhage|⟧.
•Damage increases by +0.4 for every unhealable health point
••At maximum ⟦Hemorrhage|⟧ coverage, total damage is 65 / 72 / 79
••(13 / 14.4 / 15.8 per slash)

•**Demonic Pursuit's** slash combination hits all survivors in its hitbox, similar to Gashing Wound.
•Guest 666's stamina freezes upon using this ability.
•Hitting an object will cancel the leap prematurely.
••Small obstacles, like fences, will sometimes not cancel the leap.
•The ability takes 5s to complete, with the flurry of slashes taking 2s, after which Guest 666 flings the survivor ~20 studs, ragdolling them for 2s, pausing himself for another 3s.
••This means that the survivor will have a headstart of 1 second, as well as a small chunk of distance.
abilities.quote: "Guest 666 is a demon bro, I swear on my robux they are" - Random Player

abilities.name: INFERNAL CRY
abilities.desc:
Guest 666 lets out a roar, sending a sharp shockwave after a 0.7-second windup.

•Can hit multiple survivors.
• Can be aimed in any direction.
• On hit:
••Any Survivors hit are forced to face Guest 666
••Applies ⟦Blindness|2⟧ for 4 seconds to the survivor.
••Highlights the Survivor to Guest 666 for 12 seconds.
••Survivors with ⟦Hemorrhage|⟧ will additionally drop 2 Blood Orbs.
••Guest 666 is transparent during the windup of this ability.

**Blood Hunt Bonus**

During Blood Hunt, this ability is buffed:
•Deals 10 damage.
•Applies ⟦Speed|1⟧ to Guest 666 for 3 seconds.
•Applies ⟦Strength|1⟧ to Guest 666 for 8 seconds.
•⟦Blindness|2⟧ lasts 6 seconds instead of 4.

•Guest 666 is slowed down by 25% when casting Infernal Cry
abilities.quote: ‎"That voice I heard... it was horrible." - ████

abilities.name: BLOOD RUSH
abilities.desc:
Guest 666 will smell the blood in the air, highlighting all Survivors for a period of time. The effects are as follows:
•Highlight duration increases with distance from the Survivor (minimum 5 seconds), reaching a maximum of 20 seconds at 200 studs.
•While Guest 666 is at maximum Blood, this ability is replaced with Blood Hunt

•Windup: **4s**
abilities.quote:
‎"Guest 666 is real. I saw them with my own
two eyes hacking in a game" - Myth Hunter

abilities.name: BLOOD HUNT
abilities.desc:
Guest 666 emits an ear-splitting cry, audible to all Survivors, that resets their cooldowns and starts Blood Hunt for 25 seconds. For the duration of Blood Hunt:
•Obstructive visuals affect Guest 666 and all Survivors.
•Several of Guest 666's abilities are amplified.
•Guest 666 cannot use Blood Rush.
•Movement speed increased by 4%, terror radius decreased by 50%.
•**Hellforged Will** passive is buffed to 50% negative effect reduction.
•Sees all Survivors every 5 seconds as a flashing red highlight.
•Killing a Survivor resets all cooldowns and extends Blood Hunt by 15s. The time extended by killing a Survivor decreases by??? with every kill.
•During a chase, Blood Hunt's timer decreases twice as slowly.

**Survivors with ⟦Hemorrhage|⟧:**
•Highlight flashes faster and appears white instead of red.

**When Blood Hunt ends:**
•All Blood is instantly removed.
•Maximum Blood is increased by 50.

**While Blood Hunt is active:**
•The timer continues even if not visible.
•The round cannot end by timer reaching zero.
•Disabled if only one Survivor remains; if active upon entering LMS, the remaining duration is set to 6 seconds.

•Windup: **3s**
•The round will not end if Blood Hunt is ongoing, even if the timer has run out.
•• However, if Guest 666 does not enter Last Man Standing, the game will still end as the timer registers as being at 00:00.
•Blood Hunt has no actual cooldown and can be activated as soon as Guest 666 reaches the maximum Blood requirement.
••For an example, if Guest 666 uses Blood Rush while a Blood Orb is traveling toward him, Blood Hunt will become available to activate the moment the orb makes contact. This is because Blood Hunt has no true cooldown, relying entirely on reaching the maximum Blood requirement, meaning it completely ignores Blood Rush's active cooldown.
•Two Time's respawn does not extend the Blood Hunt.
••The round timer ticks down at halved speed for the duration of **Blood Hunt**.
abilities.quote: "You'll always be my best friend Sixer, through and through!" - ████

characters.name: Nosferatu
characters.caption: Tonight, Bare witness the greatest feast of all!
characters.description: A sanguine desire, one held by those of bloody code. Tempted by a deal of infinite celebration and desire, Nosferatu arrived to bring forth the Masquerade into the realm, alongside a bloody banquet. Granted power through the Spectre, Nosferatu takes advantage of land and air. Luring those in with his manipulation of bloody code to further feast and infect those around him. Nosferatu was offered a deal in his time of need from a certain agent of the Spectre…
characters.lead: Nosferatu, or simply Nos, is a FORSAKEN-original Killer and one of the eight playable Killers in FORSAKEN, available for 1,922 Player Points, making him the second most expensive Killer (Being slightly cheaper than Azure). A vampire who focuses on stealth, mobility, and traps, he suppresses his footsteps, transforms into a bat to take flight and perform diving attacks, carves bloody puddles into the ground, throws a chain to hook and reel in his target, and hurls an orb filled with bats to disorient players.

abilities.name: LEVITATION
abilities.desc: Nosferatu levitates naturally, meaning that they don't have footstep sounds. This passive is shared with Dusekkar.
abilities.quote: "To walk without sound is to hunt without mercy." - Nosferatu

abilities.name: LACERATE
abilities.desc:
Nosferatu slashes in front of him with his claws.
•Damage: **24**
•Windup: **0.3s**
•Linger: **0.3s**
•Length: **8.5 studs**
abilities.quote: "We are the things that Robloxians fear." - Nosferatu

abilities.name: BLOODHOOK
abilities.desc:
After a 0.9s windup Nosferatu throws a horizontal chain at a survivor for 15 damage and "reel them in", triggering a brief minigame for the survivor to escape. If they fail the minigame, they receive follow-up damage. The effects are as follows:
•Can hit multiple Survivors, but can only grab one.
•Can be blocked by the environment.
•Has a range of roughly 115 studs.

•**If the projectile hits a survivor at 24 or less studs:**
••Drags the survivor and deals 3 additional damage on the kick (18 total).
••The time-based prompt does not appear.

•**If the projectile hits a survivor from long range:**
••A time-based prompt appears for both the killer and the survivor.
••The survivor gets rapidly pulled towards Nosferatu at a speed of 16 studs.
••Nosferatu can retain the grip by successfully completing an action command. Survivors that fail an action will get pulled closer towards Nosferatu.

•**If** Nosferatu **successfully pulls the survivor in:**
••Deals 25 additional damage (40 total).

•Regardless of the pull type he successfully lands, he is inflicted with ⟦Helpless|⟧ for 2 seconds and ⟦Slowness|II⟧ for 1 second.
•**If the Survivor escapes:**
••The Survivor is freed at their current position.
••Nosferatu is inflicted with ⟦Helpless|⟧ for 1 seconds.
•As a Survivor: failing button prompts pulls you closer to the Killer.
•As Nosferatu: failing button prompts make Survivor escape easier.
abilities.quote:
"We are those who arrive in the night, stalking our prey
and pulling them from prying eyes." - Nosferatu

abilities.name: CATACLYSM
abilities.desc:
Nosferatu performs a full spin to wind up their invisibility before dashing forward in the direction their model is facing. While dashing, he creates a sharp line on the ground. After about two seconds, Nosferatu is teleported back to the starting point and stomps the ground, triggering an explosion and summoning their bloody puddles. The effects are as follows:
•During the dash, Nosferatu gains ⟦Invisibility|IV⟧
•The explosion deals 10 damage.
•The puddles of blood apply 2 status effects:
••⟦Bleeding|II⟧ for 7.5 seconds, dealing 19(?) damage over time.
••⟦Slowness|I⟧ for 7.5 seconds.
•Any Survivors that step into the puddle's will be highlighted for 7.5 seconds.
•Puddles last 12 seconds before despawning.
abilities.quote:
"Dude I swear on my life I saw a vampire dash
 at like mach 5!!!" - Random Robloxian

abilities.name: HUNTER'S FEAST
abilities.desc:
Nosferatu unleashes an orb of bats after a 0.23s windup, moving toward the direction of the player's cursor. The orb can be redirected once by pressing the ability button again, giving it omni-directional control, but it cannot be redirected more than once and it cannot pass through walls. The effects are as follows:
•Deals 5 damage.
•Applies ⟦Oblivious|⟧ and ⟦Creatures|⟧ for 10 seconds.
•Highlights the survivor for 10 seconds
• If the projectile does not collide with a surface or a Survivor, it persists for 10s before despawning.

•Nosferatu**'s buffs upon hitting a survivor:**
••Gains ⟦Invisibility|V⟧ and ⟦Undetectable|⟧ for 10 seconds.
••Using any ability, including Lacerate, removes these effects.

•**Cooldown behavior:**
••The normal cooldown begins only after the projectile hits a surface or a Survivor.
••If it despawns naturally after its lifespan, the cooldown begins at despawn.
•• Redirecting the projectile starts the cooldown immediately, even if no collision has occurred.

•Redirecting the projectile also makes it travel 4 times faster.
•After casting, there is a brief window where the projectile cannot yet be redirected.
abilities.quote:
"THE BATS AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA"
 - Unfortunate Robloxian

abilities.name: ASCENSION
abilities.desc:
Nosferatu leaps upward and briefly transforms into a bat, gaining flight for up to 10 seconds. The effects are as follows:

•Pressing the spacebar flaps his wings to gain height.
•Holding the spacebar allows him to hover briefly and slows his descent. Nosferatu will only continue hovering if he flaps in-between glides.
If the 10 seconds of flight are up, Nosferatu will revert back to his normal state and gain ⟦Helpless|⟧ and ⟦Slowness|III⟧ for 4s.

Nosferatu can perform a dive attack while in bat form by using the Primary Attack.

After pressing Lacerate, Nosferatu, after a 0.6 second windup, will begin to dive downwards at an angle towards their camera's direction. Upon hitting a survivor, they will instantly revert to their original humanoid form, pin down the target, and bite them for 5 damage. Afterwards, they will perform a spinning toss that deals additional damage. This damage rapidly scales with how long you spent diving, from a base 5 damage, up to 0.55s of diving time and 30 damage maximum. (10-35 total).

If the dive attack is missed, Nosferatu takes 20 self-damage and is inflicted with ⟦Slowness|III⟧ and ⟦Helpless|I⟧ for 3 seconds.

• Nosferatu has complete invincibility during **Ascension**, meaning he cannot get ⟦Stunned|⟧ or hit by any offense ability.
• Stamina will immediately begin regenerating regardless of how Nosferatu exits Ascension.
• While in his bat-form, Nosferatu has all survivors highlighted to him.
• On mobile, Nosferatu gains height by pressing and holding the sprint button.
abilities.quote:
"You know what's in here, I know what's in here.
 Inside you'll find..." -???

abilities.name: DISMOUNT
abilities.desc:
By re-using Ascension anytime during its duration, you will automatically return to your default form.

If Nosferatu exits without using the dive attack, he will be inflicted with ⟦Slowness|III⟧ and ⟦Helpless|I⟧ for 4 seconds.

As the shockwave travels, it will leave behind a fissure in its wake. This fissure slows survivors by 70% while they are inside of it. The fissure lasts for 8s.

characters.description: The remains of a withered spirit controlled by the hands of others. Azure springs new life to shutdown and control the survivors movement. When at their zenith, Azure summons an overwhelming construct to cull any in his path.
characters.lead: Azure, full name Azurewrath, and real name Aspen, is the 8th Killer to be added to FORSAKEN and currently the most expensive Killer, costing **$2,000**. He is a FORSAKEN-original Killer. He was heavily hinted to be the next Killer when he appeared at the end of the Forsaken Roadmap Showcase on the official Forsaken YouTube channel, where a likely update icon of them was shown connected via an arrow to Jane Doe's release update. Based on their moveset, Azure is a Trapper Killer, making them the second Trapper Killer alongside John Doe.

abilities.name: ECHOLOCATION
abilities.desc:
Azure's plants are triggered by sound. If survivors sprint or use an ability near them, they will trigger and attack the survivor.

Survivors that trigger plants have their aura revealed to Azure for 3s.
abilities.quote: "The transient sounds of winds sound softer today." -Aspen

abilities.name: ATROPIC
abilities.desc:
Azure's plants apply a unique status effect named ⟦Atropa|⟧. This status effect is the primary way to gain OBLATION. OBLATION is also gained through dealing damage.

Azure gains 1 OBLATION for every stack of ⟦Atropa|⟧ on a survivor when hit with Perforating. If Atropa expires naturally, Azure gains 1 OBLATION for every 2 stacks of Atropa, with a minimum of 1 OBLATION gained.

Additionally, Perforating and Pummeling will deal 1 additional damage for every stack of ⟦Atropa|⟧ on a survivor when hit. However, this will also remove all Atropa stacks.

⟦Atropa|⟧ highlights survivors affected by it to Azure, with the highlight growing darker the more stacks they have.

Seeker Bulb's inflict 1 stack of ⟦Atropa|⟧ on hit, Stigmatize Vine's inflict 3 stacks of ⟦Atropa|⟧ on hit, and a survivor fully disarming either of them is inflicted with 2 stacks of ⟦Atropa|⟧.

⟦Atropa|⟧ can not go beyond 6 stacks, and additional stacks do not refresh the existing status timer.

Azure can have a maximum of 15 OBLATION.
abilities.quote: "May nature's hands be kinder than the folly of man.." -Aspen

abilities.name: SENESCENCE
abilities.desc:
Azure's plants are able to be temporarily disarmed by survivors.

However, Azure's Seeker Bulb's and Stigmatize Vine's begin life Blooming. Blooming plants are glowing, unable to be disarmed, and have certain traits amplified.

Seeker Bulb's will fire faster while Blooming, and Stigmatize Vine's windup is significantly faster and attack cooldown is reduced while Blooming.

if either plant is disarmed, they will enter a withered state and become inactive for 30s.

However, once a plant becomes active again, they will begin Blooming once more.

The Blooming state lasts for 40s.

•While Blooming, Seeker Bulbs' exact firerate increase is 1.33x.
•Disabling a Seeker Bulb or Stigmatize Vine will give the Survivor two stacks of Atropa.
abilities.quote: "Sometimes I dream of him being plagued by illness. Freed from them." -Aspen

abilities.name: PERFORATING
abilities.desc:
Damage: 22

Windup: 0.22

Linger: 0.25

Length: 8.5 studs

Azure jabs his tentacles forward.
This will additionally trigger any nearby plants on hit.
abilities.quote: "May your faith remain unshaken, and your strength never yield." -Elder Amarah

abilities.name: SEEKER BULB
abilities.desc:
Azure will slow down and then after a 0.86s windup will jab a tentacle forward, spawning a Seeker Bulb on the hit surface.

Upon being triggered, they will begin to fire projectiles at the survivor who activated it, dealing 4 damage and applying a stack of ⟦Atropa|⟧ on hit.

Seeker Bulbs will stop firing after 1.5s if they lose line of sight of survivors or survivors stop making noise near it.

Azure can have up to 3 Seeker Bulbs at once. Using the ability again with 3 Seeker Bulbs placed will replace the oldest one.

•It shoots in a **30 studs ** radius.
abilities.quote: "Certain types of nightshade can be fatal, so be careful..." -Aspen

abilities.name: STIGMATIZE
abilities.desc:
Azure will briefly come to a near standstill and then after a 0.8s windup will summon a Vine.

Vines have a brief 1.2s arm time after they are finished being summoned.

Upon being triggered, they will track and attempt to attack the nearest survivor to trap them. The attack has a 0.6s windup.

If the attack hits a survivor, they will take 14 damage and become snared and unable to move more than a small distance away from the Vine before being pulled back in.

Survivors are released from the snare after 5s of being trapped or they take more than 10 damage.

Upon being released, survivors gain ⟦Speed|II⟧ for 1s.

After releasing a survivor or missing an attack, the Vine will briefly wither and go on a 6.5s cooldown before being able to be triggered again.

•Trapped Survivors are still able to use their abilities.
•It can reach up to **20 studs** in a radius.
abilities.quote: "Perhaps we could ask if we could handle these overgrowths ourselves?" -Two Time

abilities.name: ENSTRANGLE
abilities.desc:
Azure becomes unable to sprint and winds up a tentacle for 1s, after which Azure can press the Perforating ability button to send a tentacle towards the targeted location.

Azure is able to cancel the ability by pressing the button again, which will set it on a shortened cooldown.

Upon hitting a survivor, they will take 10 damage and Azure will regain the ability to sprint while grabbing them and holding the caught survivor for a bit before throwing them towards the targeted location. Azure can press the Perforating ability button again to throw the held survivor early.

The thrown survivor takes 5 damage and is briefly knocked down on impact. Survivors within a 20 stud radius of the impact point are also briefly knocked down.

Azure is inflicted with ⟦Helpless|⟧ for 2s upon throwing the survivor. If the survivor is thrown too close to Azure, the duration of the ⟦Helpless|⟧ is increased and Azure will additionally suffer ⟦Slowness|II⟧ for 2s.

While using this ability Azure has their Stamina Regeneration reduced by 75%.

Thrown survivors will always trigger any nearby plants upon landing.

•Enstrangle grab cutscene grants Invincibility to Azure. Invincibility lingers for an additional 0.5 seconds after the initial grab animation ends.
abilities.quote: "Holding your hand like this... makes me not want to let go.." -Two Time

abilities.name: INFLORESCENCE
abilities.desc:
Once Azure reaches 15 OBLATION, they are able to summon the Golem.

Summoning the Golem takes 4.8s. After the Golem has finished summoning, they are able to be freely controlled by Azure by pressing the ability button again. The Golem becomes a statue when not being controlled.

The Golem has a maximum lifetime of 45s, and the lifetime is paused while not being controlled.
Swapping to and from the Golem has a cooldown of 2.5s.

Azure is unable to gain OBLATION while the Golem exists.
abilities.quote: "Rise, once more, Azurewrath."

effects.atropa: A stacking debuff (up to Atropa VI) which reveals the Survivor's aura to Azure (color ranges from pink to dark purple based on their Atropa stack) and increases the damage of Perforating (and Pummeling) by 1 for each stack of Atropa If a Survivor with Atropa gets hit by Perforating, Azure will gain Oblation based on their Atropa stack, but also completely removes Atropa from the Survivor
effects.exhausted: Reduces stamina regeneration and increases stamina drain by 10% per stack. The stamina bar turns red while Exhausted is active.
effects.bleeding: Bleed does 2 damage per second of the duration, except for the final second (eg: for 5 seconds of Bleeding, it'll do damage 4 times, so a total of 8 damage). Increasing stacks will do more damage more frequently until Bleeding V, where any higher stacks will do the same DPS. It caps out at 10 HP, and won't deal any further damage.
effects.blindness: Each stack makes your screen blurrier. Blindness I (1) makes your screen 20% more blurry, capping at Blindness III (3) at 60% blurriness.
effects.burning: Deals damage over time and sets the target ablaze, dealing 0.95 damage every 0.5 seconds (1.9/s). Each stack (from I to V) has a dps of 1.9/s, 2.5/s, 3.3/s, 4.3/s, and 6.2/s respectively, and all other stacks will do 6.2/s as well. This status effect has the ability to kill players, unlike other effects leaving them at 1 or 10 hp. However, damage can be nullified with Resistance applied.
effects.corrupted: Deals damage over time and makes red numbers 1 and 0 appear and disappear around the target. (if killer is using Abberant, the 1's and 0's are replaced with geometric faces due to Abberant's custom corruption) Each attack increases the frequency and quantity of damage. This status effect cannot kill players. The base rate of damage is 1.9/s for one stack, 2.5/s for two stacks. The increment of DPS averages at around +35% and stops at five stacks (6.2/s), with additional stacks doing nothing more.
effects.glitched: Glitches the target's Health and Stamina bars, rendering you unable to see most of the UI. Each stack of Glitched amplifies this effect, stacking up to Glitched III. If the target has the setting Center Stamina Counter enabled, Glitched removes the stamina counter beneath your crosshair.
effects.helpless: The target is unable to use their abilities for the duration of the effect. Ability icons are covered with a chain and padlock.
effects.hallucination: Hallucinations last 20 seconds before disappearing, when they disappear a placeholder image of Noli will spawn in the middle of your screen, obscuring your vision. Noli is also alerted of your position via purple highlights, with the highlights becoming darker the higher Hallucination a survivor has. Hallucination picks random hallucinations from a pool, the amount varies depending on the stacks of Hallucination (1 Hallucination at one stack, 2 at two stacks, and 3 at three.), these being: - The timer displaying the wrong time, consistently. - The wrong amount of Generators completed. - Layer 1/2 of Noli's Chase Theme starts to play constantly. - A fake Pizza from Elliot's Pizza Throw spawns, only if an Elliot is in-game. (Only spawns at Level 2+) - A fake Dispenser from Builderman's Dispenser spawns, only if a Builderman is in-game. (Only spawns at Level 2+) - A fake Shield from Dusekkar, only if a Dusekkar is in-game. (Only spawns at Level 2+) A fake Noli clone will always spawn once Hallucination 3 is hit, the clone will walk roughly towards you. It plays Noli's chase theme at the right distance, and will almost always sprint towards you when you're immediately in its line of sight. Noli will be entirely visible during the effect. You can tell the clone apart from Noli because it is only able to perform M1s and occasionally use / bait out Void Rush, and the M1s do 15 damage instead of 25. The fake Pizza and Dispensers from Hallucination 2+ appear to heal you, but the healing is reverted after the Hallucination ends, similar to the fake Noli.
effects.hemorrhage: Lowers your Maximum HP, but not your current HP, represented as a stripped black bar on your healthbar. Increases the frequency and amount of maximum health reduced per stack. Hemorrhage can be healed via a Medkit. If Max HP is lower than HP, no HP is recovered, else, only heal up to current Max HP. Clicking on another survivor will request aid, allowing them to perform a 6 second healing interaction to remove Hemorrhage. Progress is kept if healing is cancelled. Maximum HP is returned overtime once Hemorrhage wears off. This also affects some of Guest 666's abilities, such as Guest 666's Demonic Pursuit (while Blood Hunt is active) dealing more damage the more your max health is reduced.
effects.insanity: Levels 1-4 of Insanity turns your screen fully red. For some reason, after level 4, the screen turns black instead.
effects.nausea: Disorientates your screen. Every level of this status increases the effect.
effects.oblivious: Makes you unable to hear the terror radius of killers.
effects.poisoned: Deals damage over time, and tints the target a sickly green/makes certain parts of their body a sickly green. Each stack increases the intensity, speed, and quantity of the damage. This status effect cannot kill players, although it used to.
effects.slowness: Slows down your movement speed. Every level of this status lowers speed by 10%.
effects.confused: Inverts your controls. Effect worsens with each stack.
effects.stunned: Makes the target unable to move or use any abilities for the duration of the effect, and cancels the target's abilities if they were stunned during the windup. Stunned cannot be applied again while already being stunned and a short duration after the stun.
effects.subspaced: When applied, your screen is filled with a pink tint and blur (Level 1+), darkens your screen (Level 2+), and quickly turns your camera in a random horizontal direction (Level 3+). Every level of this status intensifies the effect, and increases duration; capping at subspaced X(?). Additionally, any aura read currently active is canceled. This effect has the ability to silence the killer's chase theme. (Note: This effect cannot be reapplied while it is active.)
effects.vulnerable: Receive 20% more damage per stack. You can calculate the total damage by using 0.2x\cdot(5+y), where x is damage and y is the amount of stacks. (or just multiply by.2 for every stack of Vulnerable)
effects.weakness: When applied, the target deals 10% less damage per stack. Vulnerable and Weakness used to be one and the same, but were later separated into their own effects.
effects.gouged: UPCOMING: was revealed in a discord stage. When a survivor is initially (GOUGED), Slasher gains an aura read for 5s. Only layer 1 of the chase theme will play while (GOUGED) (GOUGED) can be removed by standing still and holding an interact button. This has been rendered mostly obsolete due to the Oblivious status effect.
effects.hacked: Freezes all ability cooldowns, excluding your main Attack. Abilities already off cooldown will remain usable.
effects.fatigue: Slows down recharge rates of abilities by 20% per stack, and completely freezes ability cooldowns at 10 stacks (Fatigue X)
effects.invisibility: Makes you translucent, and mutes your footsteps. Every level of this status makes you 25% more transparent. Invisibility IV (4) does not follow this formula, making you 92.5% transparency while Invisibility V (5) makes you almost completely invisible, this means that Invisibility will never truly make you fully invisible.
effects.regeneration: Passively heals the target by 5 HP (increased for each stack). A green vignette appears on the target's screen alongside green crosses.
effects.resistance: Reduces damage by 20% per stack. Each stack of Vulnerable will pierce 1 stack of Resistance. This status effect also nullifies Burning damage. Resistance V (5) and above will mute all damage entirely.
effects.speed: Increases movement speed by 10% per stack, while also increasing your screen's field of view. Each stack of Slowness will pierce 1 stack of Speed.
effects.strength: Increases the amount of damage you deal to others. Each level increases damage dealt by 20%.
effects.undetectable: Makes detection methods (such as minions and aura reading abilities) ignore you. This also silences the chase theme when being chased by an undetectable killer as a survivor, or when chasing an undetectable survivor as the killer. The killer can still drain stamina when they are 85 studs away from an undetectable survivor.
effects.purified: Grants one-hit resistance against incoming damage. Damage reduction depends on how much health you have missing already. (+20% resistance per 20HP missing, up to 80%)
effects.haste: Speeds up the recharge rate of all abilities. Speeds up the recharge rate of all abilities by 20% per stack.
effects.slateskin: The target gains 40 overheal per stack and slows the user down by 45%. Gain immunity to Bleeding, Burning, Poisoned, Corrupted (as of the Nosferatu update), Regeneration, Speed, Hemorrhage (if applied after slateskin) and Weakness.
effects.overheal: Makes the target temporarily have more health. Overheal may behave differently depending on the source. Some effects (such as Dusekkar's Plasma Beam and Noob's Slateskin Potion) cause the extra HP to decay at a rate of 1 HP per 0.5s. However, Noob's Slateskin overheal ends immediately when its duration expires, while Dusekkar's persists until it naturally depletes if uninterrupted. In contrast, Jane Doe's Shatterpoint HP and Guest 1337's Overheal upon blocking a Basic Attack does not decay over time and can only be removed by taking sufficient damage from the Killer or map hazards. This status effect can only be applied through abilities.
effects.marked: Reveals your aura to the Killer with a red outline as opposed to the usual yellow. This bypasses the Undetectable status effect, bypassing the immunity to aura reading, but can be cleansed through gaining Undetectable while having Marked, effectively cancelling the aura reveal.
effects.resonance: Each stack increases the stun duration of Jane Doe's Hatchet, beginning with a 2.25-second stun at Resonance I, 3.25-second stun at Resonance II, and a 4.25-second stun at Resonance III. The total stun time is reduced by 30% for every Jane Doe currently alive in the match. All Jane Does share Resonance; if one Jane Doe applies Resonance to the Killer, your Hatchet will level up accordingly. Resonance immediately ends when a Jane Doe stuns the Killer, regardless of the remaining duration.
effects.stun immunity: This status is applied right when the target is stunned. Three spawn symbols orbit the target as the status is active. Lasts for 10s initially, but lasts longer for each Sentinel currently alive.
effects.invincibility: The target becomes immune to any offensive ability, as well as any negative status effects. (excluding Builderman's Sentry)
effects.imprisoned: When a survivor is afflicted with Imprisoned, small puddles of black will occasionally appear around them in a small stud radius. When these puddles appear, survivors will have a short time to react before chains shoot out of these puddles and towards the position of where the survivor was when the puddle appeared. If the survivor is hit by the chain, they will become ensnared. Survivors will slowly lose ticks of health and they will have to spam a button to fill an escape bar. Once the bar is free, they escape the chain, and the puddle disappears. Every stack of this status effect increases the number of puddles that appear.
effects.disoriented: Disoriented I: Any survivors outside a 25 stud radius will have their appearance concealed to the affected survivor. Disoriented II: Distorted faces and images will flash on the affected survivor’s screen, accompanied by glitchy droning ambience which drowns out other audio. Disoriented III: Screen becomes dark and highly saturated, limiting vision immensely. Like Hallucination, this status effect is hidden.

slasher.note: Slasher is still very formidable on this map, however there are many objects to loop around and a wide variety of larger loops that require excellent stamina management to beat a Survivor on.

nosferatu.note: Nosferatu struggles on this map for the same reason as Slasher. Due to the amount of structures, landing a Bloodhook can be very tedious against any competent Survivor, leaving his best playstyle as relying on ambushes with Bat Form to start chases.

azure.note: Azure is different and relies heavily on the Survivor's macro knowledge of the Killer and the map. Azure cannot shut down every loop or structure on this map, and due to the amount of structures it can be difficult to land his grab.

john-doe.note: John Doe struggles for the same reason as Azure, but even more so with his lower trap count.

1x1x1x1.note: 1x1x1x1 is heavily countered by Survivors abusing the elevation difference, either on the castle or the small structure in the center of the map. Any smart Survivor will loop the castle.

c00lkidd.note: These Killers are great for this map as there are not many structures around, and most of the loops are small enough for them to outplay with their higher speed than the other Killers.

slasher.note: These Killers are great for this map as there are not many structures around, and most of the loops are small enough for them to outplay with their higher speed than the other Killers.

noli.note: Noli is only hindered by the cave loop of this map, however due to the sheer lack of other loops that are as safe, Noli can easily kill someone before they get to this loop.

azure.note: Azure's traps can shut down every loop on this map, forcing Survivors to rely on stamina management more than looping, and his grab has a small enough hitbox that you can work around the trees.

john-doe.note: John Doe can shut down the strong loops but still keep weaker ones open, which he can play around easily with proper corner cutting.

guest-666.note: Guest 666 is hindered by the amount of random objects strewn across the map, hurting their ability to do long range dash attacks.

1x1x1x1.note: With his reduced windup, 1x1x1x1 relies less on 50/50s now, making his projectiles deadly with good aim on this map, and the lack of strong loops lets his speed thrive.

nosferatu.note: Nosferatu again has a difficult job hitting his Bloodhook on this map, as the amount of random objects makes it difficult to land, and his Bat Swarm can collide with the random trees.

slasher.note: Slasher is the best Killer overall for this map. He has the rushdown speed to deal with the loops and structures without relying on a dash or projectile that may get caught on the structures of this map.

1x1x1x1.note: 1x1x1x1 is good on this map as well, as there is only one area with an elevation difference, and their projectiles can go through walls, making them VERY oppressive on this map.

c00lkidd.note: c00lkidd can still make great use of Corrupt, but his Walkspeed is reduced purely to a punisher move, unable to be used as a dash for most of this map due to how many random objects are strewn about.

noli.note: Noli is great for rushdown on this map thanks to his ability to essentially stun with Nova and then combo it with Void Rush. With how close all the Survivors are forced together he gets easy Void Rush chains, however in 1v1 scenarios he struggles due to the amount of objects around the map.

john-doe.note: John Doe's traps are good for this map. There are many placements for Digital Footprint and a few spots you can trap people with Corrupt, but he gets torn apart by teamwork on this map, excelling in the 1v1 here.

nosferatu.note: Nosferatu can use his dash and Bat Form but finds little room to hit his Bloodhook, reducing him to an ambush / trapper playstyle.

guest-666.note: Sixer struggles on this map due to their size, making them easy to loop around the several structures scattered around, with little room for their dash to be used.

john-doe.tip: Dusekkar is very important for this team: any time John Doe is stunned, Dusekkar beams him to cancel his Unstoppable passive. With two Dusekkars up, Unstoppable becomes useless no matter what.

tip: Two Time can easily stun Azure out of his grab with their dash stab, forcing him out of aiming it or making him drop whoever he is carrying.

strats.name: Dynamic Stamina
strats.text: Stop sprinting before the gray bar takes over your current stamina to regain stamina faster.

strats.name: Stutter Step
strats.text: Use 10-30 stamina when the Killer/Survivor is far/close enough, then walk until you regain it, or until the Killer/Survivor is far/close enough to (not) hit.

counters.text: Bloxy Cola, if drunk before the chase

strats.name: Body Block
strats.text: When you're high on HP or the round is nearly over, use yourself to body block and stop another Survivor from dying.

strats.name: Aggro
strats.text: Get the Killer's attention so a Survivor on low HP doesn't die.

strats.name: Chill Survivor
strats.text: Miss a stun on purpose or emote near the Killer to make them chill and waste time.

strats.name: 2 Hits
strats.text: Any Survivor can trade health for speed. The extra speed lets you put distance between you and the Killer, forcing them to use more stamina while you build stamina back before getting hit. Best used at max HP, or when the Killer can't 2-shot you.

strats.name: Ability Usage Mid Chase
strats.text: Any Survivor who can use abilities mid chase can help the team, or themselves in Last Man Standing. Best used when the ability can stun the Killer to create distance.

strats.name: Spotting Noli's Fake Generators
strats.text: Complete 1/5 of a fake generator, or leave it empty, so the others know which one is fake. On a real one, complete 2-3/5 and let the others (preferably Elliot) finish it.

strats.name: Generator Hopping & Completion
strats.text: Complete at least 2/5 of a generator while your cooldowns are active. Finish it if you're a Survivalist, or if there's an Elliot on the team.

strats.name: Ability Usage Mid Chase
strats.text: Any Killer who can use their unique abilities mid chase can dish out an outburst or chip damage.

counters.text: Any Survivor, if a dash is missed
Bloxy Cola, if drunk before the chase

strats.name: Zoning

strats.name: Last Man Standing Prep
strats.text: Build up 3 charges for **Reroll** or **One Shot**, then wait for an opening to use **One Shot**. If the Killer has already been stunned or you missed, **Reroll** and repeat until you get ⟦Vulnerable|⟧, a Flintlock Explosion, or a chance to use **Hat Fix** mid chase.

strats.name: HP Threshold
strats.text: Against some Killers it's important to have a set amount of Max HP. This doesn't account for map hazards, Killer dashes, minions, outbursts and traps, ⟦Hemorrhage|⟧, Azure combos, ⟦Atropa|⟧, ⟦Vulnerable|⟧ or a Flintlock Explosion.

strats.name: Shift Tech
strats.text: When recasting **Void Rush**, hold down Shift. This uses stamina, but HEAVILY increases your speed and leaves Survivors less time to react.

strats.name: Nova Stun
strats.text: Throw **Nova** in the air above your target Survivor. It pulls them into the air and staggers them when they hit the ground, so you can catch up easily.

strats.name: Nova Combo
strats.text: Throw **Nova** at the ground when you're near a Survivor, then M1 for a free 40 damage combo. Riskier but more rewarding: hit them with **Nova**, then slam them for more damage or start a chain. Going for just the slam is the less risky option here.

strats.name: Slide Tech
strats.text: Angle yourself against a structure during **Void Rush** and you'll slide along it. Use this to counter certain loops and structures Survivors use.

strats.name: Noli Airlines
strats.text: Shift Tech off an incline (usually stairs) and Noli is sent flying upwards. Use it to go over structures, or to change the direction of a **Void Rush** when you land.

strats.name: Quiet Nova
strats.text: Use **Nova** to cover your loud ambient noise and breathing and catch people off guard. Noli's breathing is VERY loud and can give your position away.

strats.name: Flying Skins
strats.text: Any skin that flies instead of walking (Milestone 4 and Admin, for example) is quieter, which makes catching people off guard easier.

strats.name: Slide Tech
strats.text: Like Noli, c00lkidd can slide along structures during **Walkspeed Override** if he's angled against them.

strats.name: Slingshot Tech
strats.text: Dash at a Survivor with **Walkspeed Override** and hit them towards your **Pizza Delivery** minions to slingshot them in, for extremely high damage plus ⟦Slowness|⟧.

strats.name: 404 Parry
strats.text: Activate **404 Error** before a stun to trigger **Unstoppable**: the stun is capped at 2 seconds and you get ⟦Speed|I⟧ when it ends. You only need to press the ability, the aura reveal doesn't have to come through before **Unstoppable** procs. In that sense it works like Guest 1337's block.

strats.name: Mass Flickfection
strats.text: Aim **Mass Infection** away from your target, then right before the projectile fires, flick at them or at where you predict they'll run. This gives them less time to react.

strats.name: Glitched Follow-Up
strats.text: ⟦Glitched|⟧ increases your M1 damage, so follow up with an M1 after **Mass Infection** or **Entanglement** as often as you can.

strats.name: Plants Vs Zombies
strats.text: Set up a **Stigmatize** Vine (the grab trap) between two **Seeker Bulb** plants (the shooting ones). When you land **Enstrangle**, throw a Survivor into this mess for huge amounts of OBLATION and damage.

strats.name: Hook Drag
strats.text: Catch a Survivor at the edge of **Cataclysm** and land a **Bloodhook** to drag them through your entire blood pool for huge damage. This combo often lets you kill someone at full HP.

strats.name: Fake-Outs
strats.text: With no techs that don't hinder him, Shedletsky relies on mindgames: flick your camera back to make the Killer think you're going for the stun, or run at them to sell it. For the best stun in a chase, start the **Slash** swing, then flick at the Killer at the last second to get the most stun time through his endlag.
